title: Industrial Safety Officer
description:
**Job Purpose**

To ensure a safe, healthy, and compliant working environment by implementing and monitoring Environment, Health \& Safety (EHS) systems, reducing accidents, ensuring statutory compliance, and building a strong safety culture across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Safety Management**

* Implement and enforce safety policies, procedures, and standard operating practices.
* Conduct daily safety inspections of shop floor, machines, material handling, and work areas.
* Ensure machine guarding, PPE usage, lock\-out/tag\-out (LOTO), and safe work practices are followed.
* Identify unsafe acts and unsafe conditions and take immediate corrective action.
* Lead accident prevention programs and safety campaigns.

**2\. Accident \& Incident Management**

* Investigate all accidents, near misses, and dangerous occurrences.
* Prepare accident investigation reports with root cause analysis and corrective action plans.
* Coordinate with HR, Production, and Legal teams in case of serious accidents.
* Maintain accident and incident records as per statutory requirements.

**3\. Statutory \& Legal Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with:
* Factories Act
* State Safety Rules
* ESI, Workmen Compensation
* Fire \& Emergency regulations
* Maintain all statutory registers, safety records, and inspection reports.
* Coordinate with Factory Inspector, Fire Department, and other authorities.

**4\. Safety Training \& Awareness**

* Conduct safety induction for new employees, contract workers, and visitors.
* Organize periodic safety training programs for operators, supervisors, and managers.
* Conduct tool box talks and safety briefings.
* Create awareness on machine safety, electrical safety, fire safety, and emergency response.

**5\. EHS Systems \& Audits**

* Develop and maintain EHS management systems and SOPs.
* Conduct internal safety audits and risk assessments.
* Support ISO 45001 / ISO 14001 audits (if applicable).
* Monitor compliance of contractors and vendors with safety standards.

**6\. Fire \& Emergency Preparedness**

* Maintain fire fighting equipment, emergency exits, and evacuation plans.
* Conduct mock drills and emergency response training.
* Act as key coordinator during any emergency.

**7\. Environment Management**

* Monitor waste disposal, hazardous material handling, and pollution control.
* Ensure compliance with environmental regulations.
* Coordinate with Pollution Control Board and waste management vendors.

**Key Skills Required**

* Strong knowledge of industrial safety rules and laws
* Accident investigation and root cause analysis
* Safety audit and inspection skills
* Training \& communication
* Documentation \& compliance management
* Ability to enforce discipline tactfully

**Qualification \& Experience**

* Diploma / Degree in Safety Engineering, Industrial Safety, or Environmental Engineering
* Mandatory: NEBOSH / ADIS / DIS or equivalent certification
* 3 \- 8 years’ experience in manufacturing / heavy engineering / industrial plants.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Provident Fund

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

Rippling’s Product Specialist team ensures customers see incredible business transformation through Rippling's most complex products.

  

Our engagements are consultative. Our specialists deeply understand the customers’ unique pain points, offer creative solutions, and build/set up their Rippling environment to address their needs. Hence, our specialists serve as a bridge between the customer and product teams. They are instrumental in driving adoption.

  

This role is to manage a new team of IT Specialists to drive exponential impact of LTV and adoption.

  

The ideal candidate for this role has experience leading teams, building processes and systems, driving operational rigor, implementing IT products (specifically\- Apps, MDM, Okta, Azure), and working with cross\-functional stakeholders. They must also handle ambiguity, unstructured situations, and scale while leading a team with high standards.

**What you will do**
--------------------

  

* Mentor, hire, and lead a team of product specialists.
* Drive an implementation team to successfully meet KPIs: productivity, project completions, adoption thresholds, and CSAT.
* + Continuously measure the effectiveness and quality of our IT implementations and make process improvements
* Work cross\-functionally with sales, CX, and product managers to improve adoption, retention, and LTV.
* This role requires a strong understanding of the below:
* + **MDM, Identity Management solutions, or other IT\-related solutions. Familiarity with other IT products such as Google, Azure, and Okta.**
* Lead trainings for internal and external resources to increase the overall knowledge of Rippling’s IT products
* Actively contribute to the development of Rippling’s IT Products through collaboration with sales, product and engineering
* + Regularly coordinate with product and engineering teams to fix bugs and launch new features
	+ Serve as a connector between engineering, product, and other customer\-facing teams
* Organize beta programs and support GTM efforts for IT product launches

**What you will need**
----------------------

  

* 6\+ years of experience implementing IT products (prior management experience is strongly preferred)
* Strong prioritization and time management
* Self\-starter with a bias towards action, energized by a fast\-paced environment and excited to build
* Data and process\-centric leader with attention to detail and the ability to solve complex, interdependent problems
* Experience in growing teams with a learning mindset, people\-first attitude, and strong sense of responsibility for your domain
* Able to work with cross\-functional leaders to drive improvements to product and processes

The Branch Manager executes gold loan business at the branch level, ensuring revenue, portfolio quality, and operational governance. * Ensuring timely closure of spurious/bentex cases and minimizing auction\-to\-book ratio.

* Drive optimal ticket size, renewal mix, and repeat customer engagement.
* Ensure cost\-efficient branch operations.

* Ensure strict adherence to LTV, documentation quality, and purity testing protocols.
* Resolve spurious and bentex cases within defined timelines

* Monitor overdue accounts and perform timely follow\-up.

We are looking for a proactive and organized **HR cum Admin Executive** to support the organization's Human Resources and Administrative functions. The role requires excellent communication, multitasking, and organizational skills.

* Manage employee documentation, personnel files, and HR records.
* Coordinate employee induction and joining formalities.
* Maintain attendance, leave records, and payroll inputs.
* Support payroll processing and statutory compliance activities.
* Ensure compliance with labour laws, including **PF, ESIC, Gratuity, and Shops \& Establishments Act**.
* Handle employee confirmations, resignations, exit formalities, and full \& final settlements.
* Coordinate employee engagement activities and training programs.

* Arrange travel bookings, accommodation, and logistics as required.

* 2–3 years of relevant experience in HR and Administration.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Good coordination and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and work in a fast\-paced environment.
* Immediate joiners or candidates serving a short notice period will be preferred.

description:
**Junior Quality Engineer**

**Department:** Quality Assurance (QA/QC)  
**Designation:** Junior Quality Engineer  
**Industry:** Ductile Iron Pipe (DIP) Manufacturing

Job Summary

The Junior Quality Engineer is responsible for monitoring and maintaining quality standards throughout the Ductile Iron Pipe (DIP) manufacturing process. The role involves inspecting raw materials, in\-process products, and finished pipes to ensure compliance with **IS 8329, ISO 2531, EN 545, EN 598**, customer specifications, and company quality standards.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Incoming Material Inspection

* Inspect incoming raw materials, ferro alloys, cement, zinc, bitumen, and other consumables.
* Verify supplier quality certificates and test reports.
* Ensure material conformity with approved specifications.

In\-Process Quality Control

* Monitor quality parameters during:
* Melting
* Centrifugal Casting (CCM)
* Annealing
* Finishing
* Zinc Coating
* Cement Mortar Lining (CML)
* Hydrostatic Pressure Testing (HPTM)
* Conduct visual inspections to identify casting defects, cracks, blowholes, shrinkage, and surface imperfections.
* Verify socket and spigot dimensions using standard measuring instruments.

Finished Product Inspection

* Inspect finished DI pipes before dispatch.
* Verify:
* Pipe dimensions
* Wall thickness
* Length
* Socket and spigot profiles
* Zinc coating thickness
* Cement mortar lining quality
* External coating quality
* Pipe marking and traceability

Testing \& Measurement

* Perform dimensional inspection using:
* Vernier Calipers
* Micrometers
* Ultrasonic Thickness Gauges
* Measuring Tapes
* Go/No\-Go Gauges
* Assist in hydrostatic pressure testing verification.
* Coordinate laboratory testing for mechanical and chemical properties.

Documentation \& Reporting

* Maintain inspection reports and quality records.
* Prepare Daily Quality Reports (DQR), rejection reports, and NCRs.
* Record customer complaints and corrective actions.
* Support internal and external quality audits.

Quality Improvement

* Identify process deviations and quality issues.
* Participate in root cause analysis (RCA) and corrective/preventive actions (CAPA).
* Coordinate with Production and Maintenance teams to reduce defects and improve product quality.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives.

Safety \& Compliance

* Follow plant safety rules, PPE requirements, and quality procedures.
* Ensure compliance with ISO 9001 Quality Management System and company standards.
* Maintain housekeeping in inspection areas.

Qualification

* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical, Metallurgical, Production, or Materials Engineering.

Experience

* **0–3 Years** in Ductile Iron Pipe Manufacturing.
* Freshers with relevant internships or industrial training in a DI Pipe Plant may also be considered.

Required Skills

* Knowledge of Ductile Iron Pipe Manufacturing Process.
* Quality Inspection Techniques.
* Understanding of IS 8329, ISO 2531, EN 545, and EN 598 standards.
* Ability to read engineering drawings.
* Familiarity with measuring instruments.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
* CAPA Documentation.
* MS Excel \& Quality Reporting.
* Good communication and teamwork.

Equipment \& Instruments Used

* Vernier Caliper
* Micrometer
* Ultrasonic Thickness Gauge
* Height Gauge
* Measuring Tape
* Go/No\-Go Gauges
* Hydrostatic Test Equipment
* Coating Thickness Gauge
* Hardness Tester

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* First Pass Quality (FPY)
* Customer Complaint Reduction
* Rejection Rate
* Rework Reduction
* Inspection Accuracy
* On\-Time Inspection Completion
* Audit Compliance
* CAPA Closure Effectiveness

Reporting To

* Quality Engineer
* Senior Quality Engineer
* Quality Manager

Preferred Industry Experience

Candidates with experience in **Ductile Iron Pipe Manufacturing Plants only** will be preferred, particularly in quality inspection of:

* Melting
* Centrifugal Casting (CCM)
* Annealing
* Finishing
* Zinc Coating

title: Principal - Talent Strategy and Transformation
description:
### **About Zinnov**



Zinnov is a global management consulting firm that helps organizations make decisions that actually get used — and deliver results that matter. For over two decades, we’ve partnered with leading enterprises, high\-growth technology companies, and investors to answer some of the toughest questions they face:


* Where should we invest?
* How do we scale globally?
* What capabilities will win in the next decade?

Our work shapes market entry strategies, global operating models, M\&A decisions, and long\-term growth bets. We’re known for being **data\-led, execution\-focused, and outcome\-driven** — not opinion\-heavy slideware.



At Zinnov, how you work matters as much as what you deliver. We value independent thinking, crisp communication, and early ownership. With 450\+ professionals across 10 global offices, we work across industries including Digital Services, ER\&D, Enterprise Software, Semiconductors, Healthcare, BFSI, Automotive, Media \& Telecom, and Private Equity.



Zinnov isn’t for everyone. It’s for people who want steep learning curves, honest feedback, and the chance to see their work influence real business decisions — not just presentations.

**Principal – Talent Strategy \& Transformation**


**Location:** Bangalore  

**Experience:** 10\+ years \| **Employment Type:** Full\-time


**About the Role**



As a **Senior Engagement Manager / Principal**, you will lead end\-to\-end consulting engagements focused on Talent Strategy and Workforce Transformation. You will work closely with CHROs, Talent Leaders, Business Leaders, and GCC executives to address complex people\-related business challenges through structured analysis, market insights, and actionable recommendations.



This role is designed for an experienced consulting leader who can confidently engage senior stakeholders, lead multidisciplinary consulting teams, and drive predictable outcomes across multiple engagements. In addition to delivery, you will contribute to business development, solutioning, capability building, and the continued growth of Zinnov's India Consulting Parctice

  


**What You'll Do**


**Talent Strategy Consulting**



Lead consulting engagements across areas such as:


* Total Rewards Strategy
* Compensation \& Benefits Benchmarking
* Workforce Strategy \& Planning
* Talent Operating Models
* Skills \& Capability Development
* Leadership \& Succession Strategy
* Organization Design
* Employee Value Proposition
* HR Operating Model Transformation
* Workforce Productivity \& Effectiveness
* Talent Analytics
* AI led talent and workforce strategy


Develop strategic recommendations that help organizations build scalable and future\-ready talent capabilities.

  


**End\-to\-End Engagement Leadership**


* Own project delivery across multiple consulting engagements, including scope, timelines, quality, budgets, and stakeholder management.
* Translate complex business challenges into structured consulting workstreams.
* Drive analytical rigor and ensure executive\-ready client deliverables.
* Manage risks, dependencies, and project governance throughout the engagement lifecycle.

  


**Research \& Insight Development**


* Lead primary and secondary research to establish strong evidence\-based recommendations.
* Benchmark industry practices, talent models, and workforce strategies.
* Synthesize quantitative and qualitative insights into actionable business recommendations.
* Review and elevate team outputs into executive\-level narratives.

  


**Client \& Stakeholder Management**


* Build trusted relationships with CHROs, HR Leaders, Business Leaders, and GCC executives.
* Facilitate workshops, steering committee meetings, and executive presentations.
* Align stakeholders across functions and geographies to drive informed decision\-making.
* Identify opportunities to expand client relationships and support long\-term partnerships.

  


**Business Development \& Solutioning**


* Support proposal development, RFP responses, and client presentations.
* Participate in solution design and engagement planning.
* Develop resource plans, effort estimates, and commercial inputs.
* Identify opportunities to grow existing accounts and contribute to new business acquisition.

  


**Practice Development**


* Develop consulting methodologies and reusable frameworks.
* Build standardized templates, toolkits, and knowledge assets.
* Support hiring, onboarding, and capability development across the Talent Consulting team.
* Drive continuous improvement in delivery quality and consulting excellence.

  


**People Leadership \& Coaching**


* Lead and mentor consulting teams across multiple engagements.
* Coach team members on structured problem\-solving, research, analytical thinking, and executive communication.
* Review deliverables to ensure high standards of quality and consistency.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.

  


**What You Bring**


**Qualifications \& Experience**


* Bachelor's degree from a reputed institution; MBA/PGDM preferred.
* 10\+ years of experience in Management Consulting, Human Capital Consulting, Talent Strategy, HR Transformation, or Workforce Advisory.
* Proven experience leading consulting engagements with end\-to\-end delivery ownership.
* Strong understanding of Talent Strategy, Total Rewards, Organization Design, Workforce Transformation, and HR Operating Models.
* Experience working with senior client stakeholders, including CHROs and business leadership teams.

  


**Key Skills**


* Structured problem\-solving and strategic thinking.
* Strong research and analytical capabilities.
* Executive communication and presentation skills.
* Client relationship management.
* Consulting project management.
* Business development and commercial orientation.
* Team leadership and coaching.
* High ownership with an execution\-focused mindset.

  


**What Success Looks Like**


* Successful delivery of multiple Talent Strategy consulting engagements with high client satisfaction.
* Trusted advisor relationships with senior HR and business leaders.
* Strategic recommendations that influence talent and workforce decisions.
* Consistent contribution to business development and account growth.
* Strong consulting team capability through mentoring and coaching.
* Scalable consulting methodologies and reusable assets that improve delivery excellence.
* Building a Talent Practice in GE India Consulting team and building more understanding of HR, Talent and skill strategies within the team

**Why Globalisation Excellence (GE)**



Zinnov’s **Globalisation Excellence (GE)** practice helps enterprises build and scale Global Capability Centers (GCCs) end\-to\-end — from **Design \& Discovery** to **Build, Scale, and Run**.



In GE, you don’t work in silos. You:

This is where strategy meets execution — and where talent plays a defining role.


**About the Role**



As **Manager – Talent Acquisition**, you will play a pivotal leadership role in building scalable, high\-impact hiring engines for Zinnov’s Global Excellence (GE) practice. This is a role for a TA leader who combines **strategic thinking with hands\-on execution**, thrives in ambiguity, and takes deep ownership of outcomes.



You will shape and execute hiring strategy, lead high\-volume and niche hiring programs, partner with senior business stakeholders, and drive transformation initiatives across diversity hiring, process rigor, and data\-led decision\-making. **Data, Reporting \& Market Intelligence**


* Track hiring performance through dashboards and management reports
* Translate funnel data into clear insights, risks, and corrective actions

**What You Bring**

* Proactive employee support – Ensuring employee queries are handled with speed and empathy, creating a delightful experience.
* Product adoption – Driving engagement with the Loop mobile app, where employees can claim insurance, consult Loop’s in\-house doctors, and book diagnostic tests.

 **Collaboration \& Account Expansion :** You will play a key role in retaining and expanding enterprise accounts by:  

* Working closely with Enterprise Account Managers (EAMs) to ensure 100% retention of assigned accounts.
* Collaborating with Dedicated Claims Handlers and Operations Agents on large enterprise accounts (₹1Cr\+ premium) to deliver a high\-touch service experience.
* Identifying growth opportunities within accounts and sharing insights with the account team to drive upsell and cross\-sell initiatives.

 **Career Growth Path :**  

This role is designed as a stepping stone to becoming a Customer Success Manager (CSM) in either Mid\-Market or Enterprise.
As an ESM, you will gain hands\-on experience in client servicing, retention strategies, and account expansion, eventually taking on a full revenue responsibility for your own portfolio. **Who we need :** **A champion of employee benefits*** Passionate about helping HR leaders succeed and earning their trust to become your champion
* Excellent problem\-solving skills – proactive in finding solutions with internal teams and insurers/TPAs.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, stay organized, and meet deadlines.

 **Process and detail oriented*** Strong attention to detail and accuracy, especially in policy issuance, coverage enrollments, and claims handling.

Past experience handling employee benefits policy issuance, endorsements, claims, analytics is required.  
* 

  

**Collaborative and eager to learn*** Thrives in a collaborative environment, working closely with cross\-functional teams like Enterprise Account Managers, Claims Handlers, and Operations.
* Excited to launch industry\-leading technology like the Loop App, Enrolment Portals, in\-app claims submission, self\-serve endorsements tools for HR, and more.

 **Why join Loop ?**  

* Impactful Role – Directly improve the benefits experience for thousands of employees.
* Career Growth – Clear path to becoming a CSM in Mid\-Market.
* Customer\-First Culture – Work with some of the best HR teams in India to elevate employee wellness.

title: Audit & Accounts Assistant
description:
Job DescriptionPosition: Accounts \& Payroll ExecutiveDepartment: Finance \& AccountsReporting To: Finance Manager / Hospital AdministratorJob Summary

The Accounts \& Payroll Executive is responsible for managing the hospital’s financial transactions, maintaining accurate accounting records, processing employee payroll, and ensuring statutory compliance. The role involves handling billing reconciliations, vendor payments, salary processing, and financial reporting to support smooth financial operations of the hospital.

Key Responsibilities1\. Accounts Management

* Maintain and update daily financial transactions of the hospital.
* Handle **Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable**.
* Process vendor invoices, purchase bills, and payment vouchers.
* Maintain ledger entries and reconcile bank statements.
* Monitor departmental expenses and budget utilization.
* Ensure accurate posting of financial entries in the accounting system (Tally / ERP / HIS).

2\. Payroll Management

* Process **monthly payroll for all hospital staff** including doctors, nurses, technicians, and administrative employees.
* Calculate salaries, incentives, overtime, deductions, and reimbursements.
* Maintain employee salary records and payroll database.
* Generate payslips and salary statements.
* Coordinate with HR for employee attendance, leave records, and salary revisions.

3\. Statutory Compliance

* Ensure compliance with statutory requirements including:
* **PF (Provident Fund)**
* **ESI (Employee State Insurance)**
* **Professional Tax**
* **TDS**
* **Income Tax**
* Prepare and file statutory returns within deadlines.
* Maintain records required for audits and inspections.

4\. Hospital Billing Reconciliation

* Reconcile **IPD and OPD billing collections** with accounts.
* Verify insurance / TPA payment entries.
* Track pending payments from insurance companies and corporate clients.
* Ensure accurate revenue reporting.

5\. Financial Reporting

* Prepare **monthly financial reports** including:
* Salary statements
* Expense reports
* Cash flow reports
* Assist in preparation of **monthly and annual financial statements**.
* Support internal and external audits.

6\. Vendor \& Payment Management

* Maintain vendor master records.
* Process vendor payments as per hospital policy.
* Maintain purchase and payment documentation.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s Degree in **Commerce (B.Com / M.Com)** or Finance.
* Certification in **Accounting / Tally / GST** preferred.

Experience

* **2–5 years of experience** in accounts and payroll.
* Preference for candidates with **hospital or healthcare industry experience**.

Required Skills

* Knowledge of **Payroll processing and statutory compliance**.
* Proficiency in **Tally, Excel, and Hospital Management Software**.
* Understanding of **hospital billing systems**.
* Strong numerical and analytical skills.
* Good communication and documentation skills.
* High level of confidentiality and integrity.

Working Conditions

* Work location: Hospital premises.
* Working hours as per hospital administration policies.
* May be required to assist during audits and financial closing periods.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Accuracy in payroll processing.
* Timely statutory compliance filing.
* Error\-free financial records.
* Efficient vendor payment management.
* Proper reconciliation of hospital billing revenue.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

Delivery and Impact metrics of L\&D Architecture for the Region

* Provide inputs and support in designing and development of training architecture basis people insights, market insights, challenges \& opportunities specific to assigned region
* Closely work with regional leads to design, plan and execute region specific training needs
* Identify impact metrics and track the same jointly with the regional/zonal leadership
* Share joint accountability for business metrics along with Sales leadership
* Maintain strong interaction with sales hierarchy for respective region to ensure implementation of learning initiatives and their follow up activities
* Create awareness and drive usage of various sales tools \& aids, leading to a disciplined learning environment and improved productivity
  

Managing Training Delivery

* Deliver and implement variety of interventions basis architecture, and specific productivity initiatives
* Deliver flagship/regional training programs for critical audiences and drive business impact with follow\-up
* Maintain discipline of using standardized content and ensure that pre\-defined processes are followed
* Drive adoption and usage of e\-learning programs, online assessment / knowledge management system
* Maintain regular feedback interaction from regional leaders and take corrective actions
* Cater to region specific learning needs that may emerge from local challenges and opportunities
* Product and Process Induction for new hires joining the system, in addition to Accelerate/Prarambh
* Implement and review the process of calendars \& participation dashboards
* Compile and funnel all training data within timelines to the central team for upload
  

Training Effectiveness

* Maintain primary effectiveness metric as the pre\-defined vector and amplitude of business impact
* Collect and Review feedback of training on quality norms of delivery and content to improvise on the Training modules and ensure regional flavor
* Facilitate in creating and driving a monitoring system to assess change in participants post training and related impact on performance and business
* Train and mobilize internal Subject Matter Experts to leverage their experience and also to facilitate dispersal of tacit knowledge
  

Knowledge Management Framework \& Online Assessment System

* Drive adoption and usage of KMS and Online Assessment System across the assigned zone, and collate feedback for improvement
  

Learning Technology and HR / ABCU initiatives

* Work closely with business and branch influencers to propagate usage of new learning tools and cross\-sell enablers at ABFL / ABC / ABG
* Act as the first point of contact for resolving learning tech / systems issues
* Collaborate intensively with the HRBP team to drive employee engagement and central HR initiatives
* Deliver ABCU skill development trainings (in addition to own calendar) as a shared ABC learning resource, and drive ABCU agenda and periodic initiatives

The role involves evaluating operating results across the organization to ensure alignment with growth and objectives. * Guide and lead employees.
* Collaborate in the planning and formulation of organizational policies and practices.
* Manage the full recruitment lifecycle (sourcing, screening, scheduling, interviewing, selection, onboarding) for both domestic and international hires, ensuring a smooth candidate experience.
* Oversee payroll, attendance, and employee data management.
* Address inquiries through telephone and e\-mail requests.
* Collaborate with Public Relations and Legal Compliance teams to ensure smooth operations.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, including those related to disciplinary actions and grievances.
* Develop and promote an employee\-oriented culture that emphasizes quality, continuous improvement, and high performance.

**Mandatory Requirements**

* Strong knowledge of relevant statutory labor laws.
* Experience in managing recruitment processes for both domestic and international hires.
* Proficiency in payroll, attendance, and employee data management.

Job Title: Business Development Manager – Recruitment \& Staffing

Company: BluGlint Solutions

Location: Faridabad / Delhi NCR (Hybrid/On\-site)

Experience: 3–8 Years

Employment Type: Full\-Time

About Us

BluGlint Solutions is a growing recruitment and staffing consultancy specializing in IT and Non\-IT hiring across India. We are looking for a passionate Business Development Manager who can build long\-term client relationships, generate new business opportunities, and contribute to the growth of the organization.

Key Responsibilities

\* Identify and acquire new clients for permanent staffing and recruitment services.

\* Generate business through cold calling, email campaigns, LinkedIn, networking, referrals, and client meetings.

\* Develop and maintain strong relationships with HR leaders, hiring managers, and decision\-makers.

\* Understand client hiring requirements and coordinate with the recruitment team for timely delivery.

 About TalentXM
 



 TalentXM is an AI\-forward, fractional IT talent firm in the XM Ecosystem. We connect organizations with high\-caliber talent and modern, automation\-driven people practices. As an HR Intern, you will work alongside a lean, fast\-moving team and get real, hands\-on exposure to how a technology\-driven company runs its people function – including the AI and automation tools shaping the future of HR.
 



 About the Role
 



 We are looking for a motivated HR Intern who is eager to learn, takes initiative, and wants practical experience across the employee lifecycle. This is a remote, results\-oriented internship: we care about the quality and impact of your work, not the number of hours you sit online. You will support day\-to\-day HR operations while gaining direct experience with free and paid HR/productivity tools and with AI tools used in recruitment and people operations.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Support end\-to\-end recruitment: sourcing candidates, screening resumes, scheduling interviews, and keeping the applicant tracking system up to date.
 



 • Assist with onboarding and offboarding coordination, including documentation, checklists, and new\-hire communications.
 



 • Use AI tools (e.g., for sourcing, resume screening, drafting job descriptions, and summarizing notes) to make HR processes faster and more accurate.

 • Help with employee engagement initiatives, surveys, and internal communications.

 What We’re Looking For
 



 • Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, or a related field.

 Perks \& What You’ll Gain
 



 100% Remote
 



 Work from anywhere in the world. Flexible Schedule
 



 We value results over hours logged.
 



 Certificate of Internship

 A personalized Letter of Recommendation for interns who demonstrate initiative and drive results.
 



 AI \& Tools Exposure
 



 Hands\-on experience with AI and modern free and paid HR tools. Path to Absorption
 



 Possibility of being absorbed into a longer\-term role based on performance.

 Interested candidates may send their resume to partnerexperience@blocktxm.com with the subject line “HR Intern Application – \[Your Name]”. Tell us briefly why you’re excited to learn HR in an AI\-forward environment.

title: People Services Senior Generalist
description:
**Job title: People Services Senior Generalist**
------------------------------------------------

* **Location:** **Hyderabad**
---------------------------

**About the job**
-----------------


Sanofi is a global life sciences company committed to improving access to healthcare and supporting the people we serve throughout the continuum of care. From prevention to treatment, Sanofi transforms scientific innovation into healthcare solutions, in human vaccines, rare diseases, multiple sclerosis, oncology, immunology, infectious diseases, diabetes and cardiovascular solutions. As a company with a global vision of drug development and a highly regarded corporate culture, Sanofi is recognized as one of the best pharmaceutical companies in the world and is pioneering the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) with strong commitment to develop advanced data standards to increase reusability \& interoperability and thus accelerate impact on global health.


Provide effective and efficient HR service delivery to colleagues and the business, with expertise in Background Verification (BGV), Offer Management, and Employee Life Cycle processes. Maintain accurate HR systems data and produce management information to support organization design, HR decision\-making, and service delivery. Contribute to Progressive HR initiatives within Sanofi India, ensuring compliance and operational excellence.

**Main responsibilities:**

* **BGV \& Offer Management:** Manage the end\-to\-end background verification and offer management process, including coordinating with candidates and internal teams to collect, validate, and process all mandatory pre\-employment documents in Workday. Ensure timely completion of background checks and pre\-employment verifications while maintaining clear communication with candidates throughout the verification period. Validate all required hire documentation and apply necessary background and organizational checks to confirm hiring eligibility. Support the contract execution process and coordinate with recruitment partners to ensure all employment details are accurately documented and verified before candidate onboarding.
* **HR SYSTEMS:** Provide Tier 2 Support for Workday related queries. Oversee and maintain Core employee data on Workday. Carry out system administration activities – e.g. system/data checks fault\-finding and resolution. Support others using systems – e.g. Educating / Training and producing user guides. Take action as directed by Manager on HRMS requirements/activities. Responsible for ensuring the security and confidentiality of sensitive data. This covers data such as absence, turnover, grades, and job evaluation/salary/bonus figures. Ensure provisions of the Data Protection Act are followed. Configuring data and creating, maintaining and updating report specifications / templates. To maintain healthy employee relations and continually support users and various stakeholders on the use of HR Systems.
* **EMPLOYEE LIFE CYCLE:** Regularly validate and audit employee files. Collate data for regular statistical reports on HR information by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing data. Provide basic advice on the policies and procedures to employees and managers. Submit monthly payroll inputs as per management instructions and employee requests. Complete Employee Life Cycle Management from hire to retire. Support on HR Systems (Workday) for business and HR processes.
* **Tier 2 Support:** Handle employee queries related to people services process through the Tier 2 process. Assist with the planning, implementation, maintenance and documentation of all the Tier 2 process. Work within our ticketing system (OneSupport) to create detailed work logs and article documentation. Manage OneSupport tickets in a timely manner and ensure the SLA are followed. Prepare weekly dashboards and provide executive summary on weekly basis to the LT team. Work closely with the Tier 3 team and provide guidance whenever needed.
* **ON/OFFBOARDING \- All India:** Performing end to end on/offboarding activities for all the Headcount Functions. Provides consistent and effective communication regarding employee’s status and on/offboarding process. Closely monitors and ensuring the on/offboarding checklist are closed by respective stakeholders. Attends to all queries and concerns pertaining to the on/offboarding process. Assist with global initiatives pertaining to offboarding.

**About you:**

* **Experience:** 5\-7 years of experience in BGV, Offer Management, Employee Lifecycle and On/Offboarding process. Graduate / Post graduate qualification in HR
* **Functional skills:** Knowledge of the latest tools and techniques in Human Resources. Demonstrate a good knowledge and understanding of HR Operations. Strong interpersonal skills.
* **Technical skills**: Must have experience in ticketing tools like One Support, ServiceNow. Should have experience in Workday applications. Proficient in MS Office (e.g. Word, Power point \& Excel)
* **Languages**: Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Why choose us?**

* Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future\-focused team.
* Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
* Enjoy a thoughtful, well\-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
* Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high\-quality healthcare, prevention, and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender\-neutral parental leave.
* Opportunity to work in an international environment, collaborating with diverse business teams and vendors, working in a dynamic team, and fully empowered to propose and implement innovative ideas.

title: Employee Relations Partner
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.


Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.


Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.


**About The Team And The Role:**


The People Experience \- Employee Relations Partner is responsible for supporting functional, jurisdictional and subject matter expertise within the area of Employee Relations, counseling managers and employees, and providing coaching, mentorship and guidance to Leaders and Employees on a broad range of complex and sensitive issues.


The ER Partner serves as a critical issue point and works closely with People Business Partners, Legal and other COEs such as Reporting, Comp \& Benefits, and Talent Acquisition and may also be responsible for external Vendor Management. They are a key contributor in streamlining and standardising HR policies and practices!


**What You Will Accomplish:**


* Provides mentorship and coaching to the People Team and/or to managers regarding the interpretation of policies and programs, employment legislation, compliance and operational efficiencies and improvements; manages consultant workload to performance metrics for their jurisdiction; provides specialist expertise and jurisdictionally appropriate legal advice and interpretation on employment legislation for critical and/or complex cases.
* Conducts investigations for increased and/or complex employee relations complaints, grievances and ethics notices (e.g., discrimination, harassment, retaliation)
* Builds and maintains strong, trust\-based relationships with key partners at all levels of the business and collaborates with PBPs, Legal, COEs and external vendors.
* Manages escalations related to external dependencies, bodies and vendors (e.g., record management, disability management, unemployment, labour authorities and government bodies)
* Responsible for building and delivering training to business leaders across the organisation. Also handle onboarding for new People Experience team members. Lead projects related to policy development, implementation, and operational improvements.
* Manages Statutory Labor Compliance for India.

**What You Will Bring:**


* Knowledge and understanding of employment legislation, its interpretation and implementation, and of employment practices in India
* Proficiency in HR which they can demonstrate to independently mitigate business, reputational and financial risk
* Leading and participating in large projects
* Passionate about coaching and developing manager capabilities
* Experience at using effective listening, probing and investigatory skills to handle complex, sensitive enquiries and conversations with discretion, composure and compassion
* Analytical attitude, able troubleshooter adept at analysing large amounts of detailed information, diagnosing problems and recommending appropriate solutions to senior business leaders.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a fast\-paced, multi\-cultural, global organisation and to build strong trust\-based relationships with remote client groups and colleagues
* Ability to deliver high levels of performance and service excellence while managing high volume workload in a collaborative team environment
* Experience in preparation and delivery of presentations/training to managers.

**Experience:**


* 8 or more years in area of Human Resources in a global organisation
* 6 years or more, Employee Relations: jurisdictional or functional expertise
* Experience working with remote teams preferred

**Educational Requirements:**


* HR Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent
* Qualification in Employment Law
* Higher certification in Human Resource Management

**Additional Details**


eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

Successful candidates will be comfortable teaching a diverse range of adult French Language programs and courses. A DELF qualification is essential.

 **Job Duties:**



The duties of this position include, but are not limited to:


* Teaches lesson(s) prepared by the classroom teacher utilizing various materials and technologies as required.
* Leaves details for the teacher if covering a class to support a smooth transition back to the classroom teacher.
* Maintains current and accurate class records.
* Maintains attendance records daily.
* Enforce French Only Policy.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

  


**Essential Qualifications, Skills, and Attributes:**


* Bachelor’s degree from a recognised university
* A recognized French teaching qualification (DELF, TEF, etc)
* Ability to communicate fluently and accurately in written and oral French
* Demonstrated proficiency with current technology tools and online learning platforms including:
	+ Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Outlook, Teams, SharePoint and Excel
	+ Zoom and Teams in a classroom setting
* Online and hybrid teaching experience preferred
* Deals effectively and courteously with students and staff, who may come from differing cultural and linguistic backgrounds.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize, organize and complete tasks with minimal supervision.

  


**Contact Information:**



While we thank all applications, only applicants who are selected for an interview will be contacted.

 **About ELS, ILSC \& Greystone College**  

  



A world leader in language education \& vocational training, ILSC Education Group, which opened its first language school in Vancouver, Canada in 1991 and Greystone College in 2002, offers life\-changing educational experiences in Canada, Australia, and India, some of the world’s most attractive and popular English\-speaking work and study destinations. Since opening its first school in Vancouver, BC, Canada, ILSC has become a world leader in language and career training and has grown to include 8 incredible locations around the world, in Vancouver, Toronto and Montréal, Canada; New Delhi, India; and Brisbane, Sydney, Melbourne, and Adelaide, Australia.

  

In early 2022, ILSC Education Group joined forces with ELS Education Services, bringing together over 100 years of combined experience delivering life\-changing learning experiences to international students. Since 1961, when ELS Educational Services opened its first school in Washington DC, ELS has developed a global reputation for delivering top\-quality English language programs. Our mission is to provide our global community with transformative learning, living and work experiences by offering the finest language, career and higher education programs.

Sound knowledge of employment law and HR best practice.

description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurgaon, Haryana, India**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 12 years of experience as an HR business partner or HR generalist supporting leaders at global companies.
* 4 years of experience in people management.
* Experience in organizational effectiveness, including workforce planning and organizational design.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Knowledge of initiating, planning, executing, controlling, and closing the work of a team to achieve specific goals and meet specific success criteria.
* Knowledge of the full talent management process across recruiting, hiring, mobility, and development.
* Knowledge of the skills and capabilities needed to lead work, develop people, and build community.
* Ability to act as a liaison or intermediary between employees and managers.
* Ability to communicate across audiences, situations, and contexts in both a written and verbal format.

**About the job**
-----------------


People Operations strives to revolutionize human resources the same way that Google has revolutionized search. We are helping to find, grow and keep the remarkable assemblage of talent who are our Googlers. You'll be an advocate of Google's culture and values, partnering with our business leaders to help them build their organizations and make sure all people decisions are based on data. Whether coaching our clients on how to lead their teams, navigating and resolving employee relations issues or managing programs that help develop our Googlers, you are exceptionally focused on putting them first, and being as clear and transparent as possible to help Googlers understand how people decisions get made.



Great just isn't good enough for our People Operations team (known elsewhere as "Human Resources"). We bring the world's most innovative people to Google and provide the programs that help them thrive. Whether recruiting the next Googler, refining our core programs, developing talent, or simply looking for ways to inject some more fun into the lives of our Googlers, we bring a data\-driven approach that is reinventing the human resources field.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Prepare leaders and teams to embrace organizational change, shaping and executing comprehensive people plans.
* Manage clear communication of people strategies and implement organizational changes to achieve desired business goals.
* Translate company\-wide OKRs into plans tailored to the specific needs of the client organization, providing feedback to identify potential gaps.
* Identify talent gaps, organizational shortcomings, and people needs that could hinder business strategy execution; use this analysis to guide resourcing and development initiatives.
* Deliver business impact for Google by setting, communicating, and achieving team priorities that support organizational goals. Align with partners and make key decisions as needed to achieve team objectives.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

title: HR Manager
description:
**HR Manager – Job Description**
--------------------------------


**Industry:** Construction / Infrastructure  

**Experience:** 7\+ years, preferably in construction, infrastructure, EPC, or contracting companies.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Manage end\-to\-end HR operations for the corporate office, project sites, and other business units.
* Develop, implement, and regularly review HR policies, procedures, and employee guidelines in line with company requirements and applicable labour laws.
* Handle manpower planning in coordination with Project Managers and Department Heads based on project schedules and workforce requirements.
* Manage the complete recruitment cycle, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, salary negotiation, offer issuance, onboarding, and deployment to project sites.
* Ensure timely recruitment of engineers, project management professionals, commercial staff, finance personnel, administrative staff, skilled workers, and other site\-based employees.
* Monitor employee attendance, leave, late arrivals, absenteeism, overtime, site transfers, and biometric/mobile punching systems.
* Coordinate monthly payroll processing and verify attendance, leave, salary revisions, incentives, deductions, advances, reimbursements, and final settlements.
* Ensure compliance with applicable statutory requirements, including EPF, ESIC, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, BOCW requirements, Contract Labour regulations, and other applicable labour laws.
* Coordinate with labour consultants, government departments, inspectors, and legal advisors for statutory filings, inspections, notices, and compliance matters.
* Maintain statutory registers, employee records, personnel files, employment contracts, appointment letters, confirmation letters, transfer letters, increment letters, warning letters, and other HR documentation.
* Manage employee relations and address grievances, disciplinary issues, misconduct, absenteeism, workplace conflicts, and performance\-related concerns.
* Conduct disciplinary enquiries and coordinate warning, suspension, termination, or other corrective actions in accordance with company policy and applicable law.
* Visit project sites periodically to review HR practices, employee welfare, attendance discipline, accommodation conditions, and site\-level manpower issues.
* Coordinate the mobilisation and demobilisation of employees and workers based on project requirements.
* Monitor employee performance and coordinate probation reviews, confirmations, appraisals, promotions, increments, and performance improvement plans.
* Develop retention strategies for critical positions and support succession planning for key project and functional roles.
* Identify training requirements in coordination with Department Heads and arrange technical, behavioural, safety, and compliance\-related training programmes.
* Manage employee engagement initiatives, welfare activities, company events, and internal communication programmes.
* Prepare and analyse HR MIS reports covering manpower strength, vacancies, recruitment status, attrition, absenteeism, payroll cost, overtime, and other HR metrics.
* Monitor manpower cost against project budgets and support management in workforce optimisation and cost\-control initiatives.
* Coordinate employee transfers between projects, departments, group companies, and business units as required.
* Manage resignations, notice periods, exit interviews, clearance processes, full and final settlements, and issuance of relieving and experience certificates.
* Support management in organisational restructuring, manpower rationalisation, salary benchmarking, and compensation planning.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee records, payroll information, disciplinary matters, and other sensitive HR data.
* Lead and guide the HR team, assign responsibilities, monitor performance, and ensure timely completion of HR activities.
* Report regularly to senior management on manpower status, recruitment progress, employee relations issues, statutory compliance, and key HR risks.

### **Preferred Qualification \& Skills**


* MBA / Master’s Degree in Human Resources Management or a related discipline.
* 7\+ years of progressive HR experience, with strong exposure to the construction, infrastructure, EPC, or contracting sector preferred.
* Strong knowledge of Indian labour laws and construction\-industry statutory compliance.
* Experience in multi\-site HR operations and handling project\-based manpower.
* Strong recruitment capability for technical, managerial, commercial, and site\-based positions.
* Sound knowledge of payroll, attendance management, HRMS, performance management, and HR analytics.
* Strong communication, negotiation, conflict\-resolution, and leadership skills.
* Ability to travel to project sites and manage HR matters across multiple locations.

title: Human Resources Generalist
description:
We are a global specialist engineering company that creates breakthrough solutions. We are curious and like to solve problems, partnering with our customers to solve the demands of today and prepare for the challenges of tomorrow. We embrace innovation and care about outcomes that are good for business, everyday life and making a better world \- creating lasting impact for everyone.
 



 We design, build and service highly engineered products in fluid and motion control applications. We focus on five market sectors: Industrial Automation, Process Automation, Climate Control, Life Science and Fluid Control,
 



 and Transport.
 



 Process Automation is a world leading provider of flow control solutions for critical applications across the Energy, Marine and Pharmaceutical markets.
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 The HR Generalist will serve as a key member of the Business Unit HR team, providing comprehensive HR support across the employee lifecycle while partnering with managers and employees to drive business and people objectives. The role is responsible for executing core HR processes, ensuring compliance with company policies and statutory requirements, fostering employee engagement, and supporting organizational effectiveness initiatives. As an individual contributor, the incumbent will work closely with the BU HR Lead and business stakeholders to deliver a high\-quality HR service that supports business growth and employee experience.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**HR Business Support** 



* Partner with line managers and employees to provide day\-to\-day HR support and guidance on people\-related matters.
* Support the implementation of HR initiatives aligned with business objectives and workforce requirements.
* Assist managers in addressing employee concerns, performance issues, and organizational challenges.



  





**Learning \& Development** 




  




* Partner with functional managers to identify capability gaps and training needs aligned with business objectives.
* Coordinate the annual learning and development plan and ensure effective deployment of technical, behavioural, leadership, and compliance training programs.
* Facilitate employee development initiatives, including Individual Development Plans (IDPs), succession development actions, and competency enhancement programs.

title: Junior IT Security Analyst (GRC)
description:
**Job Overview**

**\# ONLY AGNIVEERS SHOULD APPLY.**

Fourth Command is looking for a Junior IT Security Analyst (GRC) to join its team in a full\-time role focused on governance, risk, and compliance activities. This position is ideal for a fresher or early\-career candidate who wants to build a career in cybersecurity with practical exposure to GRC platform management, risk assessment, standards mapping, workflow support, API integration coordination, and security documentation.

The selected candidate will support day\-to\-day GRC operations by helping manage platform activities, organizing compliance and risk\-related information, assisting in workflow configuration, supporting documentation, and working with internal stakeholders on security and governance requirements. GRC roles commonly act as the bridge between business processes and security requirements by helping organizations manage risk, maintain compliance, and improve governance practices.

This role is best suited for someone who has a strong interest in cybersecurity governance, attention to detail, and the willingness to learn how security standards, policies, controls, and technology platforms work together in an organizational environment. The role also requires a basic technical mindset, including familiarity with coding concepts and support for platform\-related integrations and process automation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the day\-to\-day management and administration of GRC platforms, including maintaining records, updating entries, supporting modules, and helping users navigate platform\-related tasks.
* Assist in conducting risk assessments by identifying risks, documenting observations, tracking remediation items, and supporting the preparation of risk registers and related reports.
* Help map security controls, policies, and internal processes against applicable cybersecurity standards and frameworks.
* Support the documentation and maintenance of major global cybersecurity standards and compliance requirements relevant to the organization, such as:
* ISO/IEC 27001
* NIST Cybersecurity Framework (NIST CSF)
* SOC 2
* PCI DSS
* GDPR
* HIPAA
* CIS Controls
* Assist with API integration\-related coordination for GRC or related platforms by supporting technical discussions, documenting integration requirements, validating data flow expectations, and working with technical teams where needed.
* Support workflow creation, updates, testing, and monitoring within the platform to improve process efficiency and task tracking.
* Provide platform support to internal users by helping troubleshoot basic issues, following up on platform tasks, and ensuring smooth day\-to\-day usage.
* Prepare, maintain, and organize GRC\-related documentation, including policies, procedures, process notes, evidence records, user guides, control documentation, and audit support material.
* Assist with audit and assessment readiness activities by organizing evidence, maintaining repositories, and supporting follow\-up actions on observations and findings.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure risks, controls, workflow requirements, and documentation needs are properly tracked and updated.
* Support ongoing improvement of governance and compliance processes through structured reporting, documentation quality, and process discipline.

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

* Fresher candidates can apply.
* Bachelor’s degree required in:
* BSc (IT)
* BSc (Cyber Security)
* BSc (Computer Science)
* BCA
* Candidate must have a minimum academic qualification of above 7\.0 CGPA in their qualifying degree.
* Good understanding or academic exposure to cybersecurity, information security, governance, risk, or compliance concepts is preferred.
* Basic awareness of major global cybersecurity standards and frameworks is required, especially ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, SOC 2, PCI DSS, GDPR, HIPAA, and CIS Controls.
* Understanding of risk assessment concepts, control documentation, and process\-based security work is preferred.
* Basic knowledge of GRC platforms, compliance tools, ticketing systems, or workflow\-based platforms will be an advantage.
* Basic coding knowledge is required, with familiarity in technologies such as Python, React, Node.js, or similar tools useful for platform support, automation, integrations, and technical coordination.
* Understanding of APIs, system integration basics, and data flow concepts will be beneficial for this role.
* Good documentation skills are essential, as the role involves preparing and maintaining process documents, policies, records, and support material.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills are important for working with internal teams and supporting compliance\-related coordination.
* Good analytical thinking, attention to detail, and willingness to learn are important for success in a GRC\-focused role.

**Working Model**

This is a full\-time role with Fourth Command and is suitable for candidates who are comfortable working in a structured professional environment with process\-driven responsibilities. The role may involve regular coordination with internal stakeholders, platform users, technical teams, and compliance\-related functions.

The position is best suited for candidates who are interested in long\-term growth in cybersecurity governance, risk management, compliance operations, and platform\-based security process management. Consistency, discipline, and comfort with documentation\-heavy and process\-oriented work will be important in this role.

**Mindset and Commitment**

Fourth Command is looking for a candidate who is sincere, detail\-oriented, and genuinely interested in building a career in cybersecurity with a governance and risk focus. Since this is a junior role, the company will value learning attitude, accountability, and willingness to work patiently on structured tasks such as documentation, risk tracking, platform updates, and workflow support.

The ideal candidate should be proactive, organized, and capable of balancing technical understanding with process discipline. A strong sense of ownership, professional communication, and readiness to learn both business and security requirements will be important for long\-term success in this role.

This position is well suited for someone who wants to grow in the GRC domain by gaining hands\-on exposure to cybersecurity standards, risk assessment, platform management, workflow support, integrations, and security documentation in a professional consulting environment.

title: Product Manager
description:
**The Role**

We are looking for a hungry, detail\-oriented **Business Analyst** to bridge the gap between our business operations and our engineering team.

You will start by owning the requirements for our internal operations ecosystem, designing **autonomous AI Agents** that assist sales, support, and operations. You will own the entire feature lifecycle—from the initial PRD using **BDD frameworks**, to delegating tasks to developers, and finally testing the delivery. As you master our internal systems, your role will expand into analyzing and scoping out brand\-new product features for our end\-users.

**What You Will Do (Key Responsibilities)**

* **PRD Management (Using BDD):** Craft clear, concise Product Requirement Documents. We use **Behavior\-Driven Development (BDD)** to write requirements in the simplest possible words—breaking things down into clear **rules \& scenarios** (Given/When/Then) so everyone is aligned.
* **Scope AI \& Internal Tools:** Define requirements for our internal apps (e.g., Admin Panel) and AI initiatives:
* An *AI Sales Copilot* that automates user onboarding while salespeople monitor the flow.
* An *AI Support Quality Agent* that analyzes support calls to assist the Support Lead.
* An *AI Night\-Shift Support Agent* that handles customer queries autonomously after hours.
* **Requirement Delegation:** Hand over and explain requirements seamlessly to the Development Team, ensuring they clearly understand the business logic and edge cases before they start coding.
* **End\-to\-End Testing:** Act as the final gatekeeper. When the development team delivers a feature, you will test it against your BDD scenarios to ensure it works exactly as intended.
* **Product Evolution:** Transition into analyzing, benchmarking, and defining user\-facing product features as internal tooling milestones are achieved.

**Who You Are**

* **The Experience:** 1 to 2 years of experience as a BA, Product Analyst, or QA. **OR** a sharp fresher who can demonstrate a deep understanding of the BA lifecycle and has at least one solid internship under their belt.
* **The BDD Mindset:** You know how to communicate complex features using simple "rules and scenarios". Experience writing Gherkin/BDD syntax is a massive plus.
* **Full\-Lifecycle Ownership:** You aren't just a writer; you enjoy passing the baton to developers and rolling up your sleeves to test the final product.
* **AI Enthusiast:** You don't need to be a coder, but you must be fascinated by AI tools, ChatGPT/LLMs, and how agents can automate manual work.
* Preference will be given to local candidates only.

**Analytical Thinker:** You look at a messy manual process and immediately start drawing a mental flowchart on how to optimize it

description:
Noida, Uttar Pradesh
  
Job Summary
  
  

About the Role
  
  

We are looking for a GenAI Agentic Developer to design, build, integrate, test, and support intelligent applications powered by Large Language Models, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation, tool\-calling workflows, autonomous agents, and agentic AI frameworks. The role requires strong programming fundamentals, practical exposure to GenAI application development, and the ability to connect LLMs with enterprise data sources, APIs, workflow systems, vector databases, and cloud\-based AI services. The candidate should be able to contribute to AI assistants, chatbots, knowledge search solutions, document intelligence use cases, automation agents, and production\-ready GenAI features with appropriate controls for accuracy, reliability, safety, cost, and performance.
  
  

This role is suitable for candidates with 0 to 5 years of relevant experience . Freshers or entry\-level candidates should demonstrate strong project, internship, certification, GitHub, hackathon, academic, or portfolio\-based exposure in Python, GenAI, LLM applications, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, vector search, chatbot development, AI\-assisted automation, or agentic workflow prototypes.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Develop GenAI applications using Python, LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, embeddings, vector search, and agentic AI frameworks.
  
Build AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, tool calling, function calling, workflow orchestration, memory usage, task decomposition, and multi\-step execution.
  
Design and implement RAG and Agentic RAG pipelines using document ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata tagging, embeddings, vector indexing, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, prompt construction, and grounded response generation.
  
Integrate GenAI solutions with structured and unstructured enterprise data sources such as documents, databases, SharePoint repositories, knowledge bases, APIs, ticketing systems, and workflow platforms.
  
Implement prompt templates, system prompts, reusable prompt libraries, structured outputs, JSON response formats, prompt versioning, and output validation logic.
  
Create tool integrations that allow agents to call APIs, execute workflows, retrieve data, summarize content, classify information, generate reports, and trigger downstream actions safely.
  
Support model selection and configuration based on use case needs such as accuracy, latency, context window, token usage, cost, privacy, and deployment constraints.
  
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, knowledge repositories, search services, and automation workflows.
  
Use frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar tools to build agentic workflows.
  
Create reusable components for prompt templates, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, memory handling, guardrails, model evaluation, tracing, observability, and monitoring.
  
Perform testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for factual accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, groundedness, safety, bias, latency, token usage, cost, and reliability.
  
Implement basic Responsible AI and security controls such as input validation, prompt injection mitigation, PII handling, access control, auditability, and safe response handling.
  
Support deployment and integration of GenAI components into backend services, web applications, automation workflows, and cloud\-hosted environments.
  
Support testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, latency, cost, safety, and reliability.
  
Collaborate with data engineers, backend developers, cloud engineers, QA teams, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver AI\-enabled features.
  
  

Document prompts, agent flows, API integrations, model configurations, assumptions, limitations, and deployment steps.
  
  

Skill Requirements
  
  

Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  

Strong programming capability in Python , including data structures, APIs, object\-oriented programming, exception handling, logging, debugging, package management, and modular application development.
  
Hands\-on exposure to Generative AI, Large Language Models, prompt engineering, embeddings, tokenization, context windows, structured outputs, and AI application development .
  
Working knowledge of RAG architecture , including document processing, chunking strategies, metadata design, vectorization, semantic search, hybrid search, reranking, context augmentation, and grounded response generation.
  
Experience or strong project exposure in agentic AI concepts such as tool calling, function calling, planning, memory, reflection, reasoning loops, task decomposition, autonomous execution, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and workflow orchestration.
  
Exposure to frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI , or equivalent agentic development frameworks.
  
Experience integrating LLMs through APIs or cloud AI services such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, or open\-source model endpoints.
  
Working knowledge of vector databases or semantic search platforms such as FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search, or pgvector.
  
Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, authentication, backend integration, data ingestion, and application deployment basics.
  
Working knowledge of Git, code reviews, debugging practices, documentation, and Agile delivery methods.
  
  

Preferred / Additional Skills
  
  

Exposure to cloud\-native AI services, especially AWS Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Google Vertex AI, or Gemini APIs.
  
Familiarity with multi\-agent systems, supervisor\-agent patterns, planner\-executor workflows, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and agent evaluation methods.
  
Knowledge of LLMOps or GenAIOps practices, including prompt versioning, model configuration management, monitoring, tracing, evaluation, and cost tracking.
  
Exposure to OCR, document intelligence, NLP, text classification, summarization, entity extraction, and enterprise knowledge search use cases.
  
Basic understanding of model evaluation metrics, hallucination reduction, grounded responses, guardrails, responsible AI, privacy, and security controls.
  
Experience with FastAPI, Flask, Streamlit, React, Node.js, or similar tools for building AI\-enabled applications and demos.
  
Other Requirements
  
  

Experience Criteria
  
  

0 to 5 years of relevant experience in GenAI development, AI application engineering, Python development, ML/NLP application development, backend development, or automation engineering.
  
Candidates with 0–1 year of experience should demonstrate capability through academic projects, internships, certifications, GitHub repositories, hackathons, prototypes, or hands\-on GenAI experiments.
  
Candidates with 2–5 years of experience should have hands\-on experience building, integrating, testing, or deploying GenAI, AI assistant, chatbot, RAG, automation, or agentic workflow solutions.
  
  

Educational Qualifications
  
  

**Mandatory Qualification:**  

B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electronics, Software Engineering, or any other relevant engineering stream.
  
  

**Equivalent qualifications may also be considered:**  

BCA / MCA / M.Tech / M.Sc. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, or related disciplines from a recognized institution or university.
