We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.
### **What role will you play?**

  



In this role, you will manage various month\-end processes, including journal entries and reconciliations. Collaborating with various stakeholders including external auditors, you will maintain accurate records, provide comprehensive reporting on financial metrics and oversee statutory reporting whilst ensuring compliance with financial standards. In addition to your function, you will drive process improvements and efficiency initiatives to contribute to the operational excellence of your team.
### **What you offer**

  



* Qualified CA fresher.
* Good understanding of reporting requirements under IFRS, particularly standards that are relevant to the banking industry.
* Prior article experience in product control, finance control, investment banking middle office, financial services, equity research and stock broking firms will be preferred.
* Good understanding of P\&L analysis and attribution, financial markets, product risks, derivatives, and non\-derivatives.
* FRM certification and exposure to IFRS accounting environment are advantageous.


We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply.
### **What we offer**

  



At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that’s rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on eligibility criteria, include:

  

* 1 wellbeing leave day per year
* 26 weeks’ paid maternity leave or 20 weeks’ paid parental leave for primary caregivers along with 12 days of paid transition leave upon return to work and 6 weeks’ paid leave for secondary caregivers
* Company\-subsidised childcare services
* 2 days of paid volunteer leave and donation matching
* Benefits to support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing including comprehensive medical and life insurance cover, the option to join parental medical insurance plan and virtual medical consultations extended to family members
* Access to our Employee Assistance Program, a robust behavioural health network with counselling and coaching services
* Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities, including reimbursement for professional membership or subscription
* Hybrid and flexible working arrangements, dependent on role
* Reimbursement for work from home equipment


### **About Financial Management, People and Engagement**

  



Financial Management, People and Engagement (FPE) provides a single interface for Macquarie’s businesses across key areas of people, strategy, communications and financial management. Comprising two pillars – Financial Management, and People and Engagement – it is responsible for managing the Group’s financial, tax and treasury activities and strategic priorities, fostering our culture through people and community engagement strategies, and engaging with stakeholders to protect and promote Macquarie’s reputation globally.
### **Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion**

  



We are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and welcome all identities, including race, ethnicity, cultural identity, nationality, gender (including gender identity or expression), age, sexual orientation, marital or partnership status, parental, caregiving or family status, neurodiversity, religion or belief, disability, or socio\-economic background. title: Biomedical Engineer
description:
Job Summary

The Biomedical Engineer is responsible for the installation, inspection, preventive maintenance, calibration, troubleshooting, repair, and safe operation of all biomedical equipment in the hospital. The role ensures that all medical equipment functions efficiently, complies with regulatory standards, and supports uninterrupted patient care.

Key Responsibilities Equipment Management

* Install, test, and commission new biomedical equipment.
* Perform preventive maintenance according to the maintenance schedule.
* Diagnose and repair faulty medical equipment promptly.
* Coordinate with vendors for servicing, warranty claims, and Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC).
* Maintain equipment inventory, service records, and maintenance history.

Calibration \& Compliance

* Ensure timely calibration of all medical equipment.
* Maintain calibration certificates and service documentation.
* Ensure compliance with NABH standards and applicable biomedical safety regulations.
* Participate in internal and external audits related to biomedical equipment.

Breakdown Maintenance

* Attend equipment breakdowns immediately and minimize downtime.
* Coordinate with users and service engineers for emergency repairs.
* Verify equipment functionality before handing it back for clinical use.

Documentation

* Maintain preventive maintenance logs, service reports, breakdown records, and equipment history cards.
* Update AMC/CMC schedules and warranty details.
* Prepare monthly maintenance reports and equipment status reports.

User Training

* Train doctors, nurses, and technicians on the safe and correct operation of medical equipment.
* Educate staff on basic troubleshooting and routine equipment care.

Safety \& Quality

* Conduct regular electrical safety checks of medical equipment.
* Ensure safe handling and disposal of defective components.
* Follow hospital safety policies and infection control guidelines.
* Assist during inspections, audits, and accreditation activities.

Coordination

* Coordinate with Nursing, ICU, OT, Radiology, Laboratory, and other departments regarding equipment requirements.
* Liaise with equipment suppliers and manufacturers for technical support and upgrades.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of biomedical equipment and medical technology.
* Excellent troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Knowledge of preventive maintenance and calibration procedures.
* Familiarity with NABH standards and hospital quality systems.
* Good communication and documentation skills.
* Ability to prioritize emergency equipment breakdowns.

Educational Qualification

* Bachelor's Degree (B.E./B.Tech.) or Diploma in Biomedical Engineering or an equivalent qualification.

Experience

* **0–2 years:** Biomedical Engineer (Fresher/Junior)
* **2–5 years:** Hospital biomedical equipment maintenance preferred.
* Experience in NABH\-accredited hospitals is an added advantage.

Equipment Handled

* Patient Monitors
* Multipara Monitors
* ECG Machines
* Defibrillators
* Ventilators
* Syringe \& Infusion Pumps
* Anesthesia Workstations
* OT Lights \& OT Tables
* Electrosurgical Units (Cautery)
* ICU Equipment
* X\-Ray Machines
* CT Scan \& MRI (coordination with OEMs)
* Ultrasound Machines
* Laboratory Analyzers
* Autoclaves \& Sterilizers
* Suction Machines
* Oxygen Concentrators
* Nebulizers
* Other biomedical devices used in the hospital

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Preventive maintenance completed on schedule.
* Equipment uptime maintained above 98%.
* Breakdown response within defined turnaround time.
* Calibration completed before due dates.
* Zero major audit non\-conformities related to biomedical equipment.
* Accurate and up\-to\-date maintenance documentation.

Working Conditions

* Rotational shifts and on\-call availability for emergency equipment breakdowns.
* Availability during weekends or holidays if required for critical equipment maintenance.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Job Description – HR Executive

**Company:** **VELLA NOVA**  
**Job Title:** HR Executive  
**Department:** Human Resources  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Location:** Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh

About Vella Nova

Vella Nova is a premium fragrance brand committed to creating luxurious, long\-lasting perfumes that blend elegance with innovation. We are building a passionate team that shares our vision of delivering exceptional products and experiences to customers.

Job Summary

The HR Executive will be responsible for managing the end\-to\-end recruitment process, supporting employee onboarding, maintaining HR records, and ensuring smooth day\-to\-day HR operations. The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, strong organizational abilities, and a passion for building high\-performing teams.

Key ResponsibilitiesEmployee Recruitment

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for all departments.
* Prepare and publish job descriptions on recruitment portals and social media.
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, and other recruitment channels.
* Screen resumes and shortlist suitable candidates.
* Schedule and coordinate interviews with hiring managers.
* Conduct initial HR interviews and evaluate candidates.
* Coordinate salary discussions and offer letter issuance.
* Maintain a database of candidates and recruitment reports.
* Build and maintain a talent pipeline for future hiring needs.

Onboarding \& Employee Management

* Coordinate employee joining formalities and documentation.
* Conduct employee induction and orientation programs.
* Maintain employee personnel files and HR records.
* Assist employees with HR\-related queries and policies.
* Track employee attendance, leave records, and probation periods.
* Support employee engagement and retention initiatives.

HR Operations

* Maintain HR documentation and ensure compliance with company policies.
* Coordinate performance review documentation.
* Assist in drafting HR policies, SOPs, and employee communications.
* Support payroll by providing accurate attendance and employee data.
* Ensure confidentiality of employee information.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in HR or recruitment (freshers with strong recruitment skills may also apply).
* Knowledge of recruitment platforms and interview processes.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint).
* Ability to multitask and work in a fast\-paced environment.

Preferred Skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Strong negotiation and coordination skills.
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.
* Professional attitude with high ethical standards.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Team\-oriented mindset with attention to detail.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Time\-to\-hire for open positions.
* Quality of candidate selection.
* Recruitment target achievement.
* Employee onboarding completion rate.
* Employee retention during the probation period.
* Accuracy and maintenance of HR documentation.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work with a growing premium perfume brand.
* Professional growth and career development.

* Performance\-based incentives and recognition.
* Employee\-friendly workplace culture.

title: INTERN - Project Manager — Video Production & Delivery (Entry-Level Welcome)
description:
**READ THIS PART CAREFULLY — WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

The single most important quality for this role is deep attention to detail — and here, that means an eye and an ear for VIDEO.

You will be the last line of quality on every video before it ships. That means catching:

\- A jerky or unnatural movement in the visuals

\- Audio that drifts out of sync with the video, or levels that feel off

\- A subtitle with a grammar mistake, a wrong word, or timing that doesn't match the speech

\- A voice that sounds wrong for the character, a scene that cuts awkwardly, a frame that looks broken

\- A file named wrong, a step silently skipped, a task marked "done" that isn't

We can teach you the tools, the pipeline, and the workflow. We cannot teach you to notice. If you're the kind of person who spots the one flaw in a video everyone else scrolled past, this role will fit you. If you're not, no technical skill will compensate.

Because subtitles and scripts pass through your hands on every video, excellent English is required — you must catch language errors on sight, not just process text.

Technical background matters, but it is second. A detail\-obsessed fresher with a sharp eye will beat a careless expert in this seat every time.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

\- End\-to\-end responsibility for video production — from raw materials to finished, publish\-ready videos, across multiple languages

\- Final quality check on every video: visuals, audio, sync, subtitles, pacing — nothing ships that you haven't verified

\- Managing the video editor and coordinating their work with the rest of the production process

\- Driving the build: coordinating the engineering team so the remaining pieces of the system (dashboards, workflows, integrations) actually get built, structured, and finished — not left half\-done

\- Task management: assigning work, following up relentlessly, clearing blockers, making sure nothing stalls silently

\- Verification: confirming completed work against clear proof — never accepting "done" at face value

\- The delivery workflow on GitHub — keeping issues and pull requests organized and moving (we will train you on this)

\- Clear, concise written status reporting to the founder — accurate, specific, decision\-ready

Company: ACIS Labs

Location: On\-site — Chandigarh (this is an in\-office role, not remote)

Job Type: Full\-time

Schedule: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM, Monday to Saturday (6 days/week), with 1 hour flexible break

ABOUT US

ACIS Labs is building an intelligent, AI\-driven video production system for global, multi\-language YouTube content. We are in the build phase — core components exist, and the work now is bringing them together into a complete, structured production operation that reliably turns out high\-quality video content at scale. Further details will be shared with shortlisted candidates.

THE ROLE

This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's role. You will help take a system that exists in powerful pieces and drive it into a complete, disciplined production operation — and then own its output.

You will carry end\-to\-end responsibility for video production. AI systems do a lot of the heavy lifting, and a video editor (working under you) does the assembly — but whether every video actually comes out right is YOUR responsibility. You will coordinate the engineering work, drive the remaining pieces to get built and structured, manage the production process from raw material to finished video, and be the founder's eyes on every detail of the operation.

You are not expected to write code or make technical design decisions — the technical direction is set. You ARE expected to drive, build\-coordinate, verify, and above all: notice everything.

REQUIREMENTS

\- A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or a related technical field (recent graduates welcome — this is an entry\-level\-friendly role)

\- **Demonstrated deep attention to detail — in your application, your projects, anywhere. We will test for this.**

\- Excellent English — strong enough to catch grammar, word\-choice, and phrasing errors in subtitles and scripts on sight

\- A genuine eye for video and ear for audio — you notice when something looks or sounds even slightly wrong

\- Enough technical literacy to read and reason about dashboards, file structures, and pull requests — you don't need to code, but you can't be lost in a technical conversation

\- High ownership: you close every loop you open, without being reminded

\- Comfortable holding others to a standard, including people more experienced than you

NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)

\- Familiarity with GitHub, Python projects, or AI tools

\- Any video editing, video QC, or content production exposure

\- Any coordination experience — college projects, clubs, events, internships

GROUND RULES

\- On\-site in Chandigarh, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM, Monday to Saturday

\- Personal phones not allowed during work hours. You may only access your personal phones and devices during big break hours.

COMPENSATION

Competitive, discussed at interview based on profile. Monthly payment. You are joining at the build stage — strong performance here means growing into significant responsibility as the operation scales.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Submit the following, exactly as described:

1\. Your CV (PDF format)

2\. A short written note (5–8 sentences, no more) answering: describe one specific time you caught a mistake or flaw that others had missed — in a video, a document, a project, anything. What was it, how did you notice it, and what did you do?

3\. In the subject line or first line of your application, include the phrase: "Detail is the job."

title: Technical Writer
description:
**Job Summary**
 We are looking for a Technical Writer to join Compatio and own the documentation and content layer that
   

  

 makes our product easy to understand, adopt, and champion. You will translate complex product and technical
   

  

 concepts into clear documentation for developers and end users, while also creating marketing content — case
   

  

 studies, presentations, and web copy — that communicates our product's value to the outside world.
   

  

 This is a high\-visibility role at the intersection of engineering, product, and marketing. If you enjoy turning
   

  

 complexity into clarity — for both technical and non\-technical audiences — this role was designed for you.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As a Technical Writer at Compatio, you will build and maintain a thorough understanding of the complete
   

  

 product suite over time. Your primary charter is to create accurate, well\-structured technical documentation and
   

  

 compelling marketing content that serves both internal technical audiences and external customers.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Documentation Development
   

  

* Create and manage technical documentation, including product documentation, API documentation,


 technical specifications, and release notes.
   

  

* Organize and write supporting documents for products.
* Study product samples and talk with product designers and developers to understand functionality.
* Determine the documentation needs of end users.
* Work with technical staff to make products easier to use, reducing the need for lengthy instructions.
* Use photographs, drawings, diagrams, animation, and charts to increase users' understanding.
* Select the appropriate medium for the message or audience, such as manuals or online videos.
* Standardize content and terminology across platforms and media.
* Revise and update documents as products evolve or new issues arise.
* Maintain basic familiarity with the SDLC and software development practices.


 Marketing \& Content Creation
   

  

* Develop compelling marketing material — including presentations, case studies, and website


 content — that communicates product features and benefits to target audiences.
   

  

* Create content marketing campaigns to drive leads and subscribers.
* Apply SEO best practices to generate traffic to the website.
* Regularly produce various content types, including email, social media posts, blogs, and white


 papers.
   

  

* Actively manage and promote the company blog, and pitch articles to relevant third\-party platforms.
* Edit and refine content produced by other members of the team.
* Analyze content marketing metrics and adjust strategy as needed.
* Work closely with product owners and developers to ensure documentation accuracy and completeness.
* Collaborate with internal teams on product and documentation requirements.
* Gather usability feedback from customers, designers, and manufacturers.
* Collaborate with other departments to generate innovative content ideas.


 Industry Awareness \& Innovation
   

  

* Stay up to date with industry trends and best practices in technical writing and documentation.
* Suggest innovative, new\-age ideas for technical documentation.
* Adapt writing style and tone to target different audience segments — both external customers and internal technical audiences.


**Qualification Required**
* 4\+ years of industry experience as an effective technical writer.
* Experience managing documentation in Postman and Confluence.
* Proven ability to quickly learn and understand complex topics.
* Previous experience writing documentation and procedural materials for multiple audiences.
* Good written and verbal communication skills, with a keen eye for detail.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and Word.
* Basic familiarity with the SDLC and software development.
* University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent preferred.


**Preferred**
* Experience with GitBook or similar documentation platforms.
* Familiarity with video editing tools such as Adobe Captivate and Adobe Premiere.
* Working knowledge of Figma for visual and UI\-related documentation.
* Prior experience in content marketing, SEO, or growth\-focused content.
* Background in a SaaS or technology product company.


**What You'll Bring**
* A genuine curiosity about how products work and a passion for making that knowledge accessible.
* Comfort moving between highly technical writing and audience\-friendly marketing content.
* A keen eye for detail and consistency across documentation and content.
* Ownership mentality — you take documentation and content from concept through to publication.


**What We Offer**
* Impactful Work
* Competitive Package
* Flexible Environment
* Growth \& Learning Compatio India Pvt. Ltd.

**WHAT WE DO AND WHO WE ARE** 




 Join the dynamic team at Wholsum Foods and be part of an extraordinary movement! Our

 healthy and delicious alternatives to the junk food epidemic. It's time to rediscover the nutritious

 Millet.
 



  





 Led by founders \- Shauravi Malik and Meghana Narayan, we are food enthusiasts,
 



 entrepreneurs, and mothers committed to making a difference. We're expanding globally and
 



 seeking talented individuals who thrive in a collaborative, innovative, and high\-growth
 



 environment. Join us and embark on a rewarding journey where you can grow professionally
 



 while having a blast!
 



  





 At Wholsum Foods, we celebrate diversity and unity, all driven by a shared mission to
 



 revolutionize the way we eat. Our team is our greatest asset, and our core values—Relationship
 



 First, Dependable, Passionate, and Growth Mindset—bring out the best in each team member.
 



 We take pride in being an equal opportunity workplace, embracing individuals regardless of
 



 race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or gender
 



 identity. Together, we will redefine the future of food!
 



  





**We are also Great Place to Work Certified.** 




  





**WHAT WILL YOU DO AT WHOLSUM FOODS?** 




 The HR Business Partner will support the people agenda of a fast\-growing D2C food startup by partnering with business leaders on workforce needs, enabling effective execution of people processes, and strengthening organizational capability in line with business goals. HR Business Partners work closely with managers and key stakeholders to align people team priorities with commercial and operational requirements.
 


* Role 1: HR Business Partner – Talent Acquisition
* Role 2: HR Business Partner – Talent Management



 Both roles will support business partnering and recruitment for assigned functions, while each role will carry a distinct area of specialization. Talent Acquisition is centered on sourcing, assessing, hiring, and onboarding talent, while Talent Management focuses on performance, engagement,development, and workforce effectiveness.
 



  





**EXPERIENCE REQUIRED** 



* 6 months to 3 years of relevant experience in human resources, recruitment, talent acquisition, talent management, HR operations, or business partnering support.
* Prior exposure to startup, D2C, food, FMCG, retail, or other high\-growth business environments will be preferred.



  





**JOB PURPOSE** 




 To partner with business teams in delivering people priorities through effective hiring support, employee lifecycle management, and execution of HR processes with strong business acumen and execution excellence.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Partner with business leaders and hiring managers to understand organization structure, manpower requirements, workforce challenges, and team priorities.
* Support recruitment for assigned functions, including role briefing, candidate coordination, interview scheduling, offer follow\-up, and onboarding support.
* Act as a business\-facing HR partner for assigned teams on employee lifecycle processes, policy implementation, employee queries, and manager coordination.
* Ensure high standards of responsiveness, documentation quality, process discipline, and execution excellence across day\-to\-day HR activities.
* Maintain effective stakeholder relationships and contribute to a professional, compliant, and business\-aligned HR environment.



  





**Role 1: HR Business Partner \& Talent Acquisition** 




 To drive hiring outcomes for assigned functions while providing HR business partnering support to business teams, ensuring timely recruitment, strong candidate experience, and disciplined execution of onboarding and employee lifecycle processes. Talent Acquisition roles focus on building talent pipelines, managing the end\-to\-end hiring process, and aligning recruitment delivery with current and future business needs.
 



  





**Key Deliverables:\-** 



* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for assigned positions from requisition intake to joining closure.
* Build and maintain talent pipelines for current and anticipated hiring requirements.
* Support sourcing, screening, interview management, offer processing, and onboarding transition.
* Partner with managers on hiring plans, role calibration, candidate quality, and recruitment progress reviews.
* Provide HRBP support on onboarding, employee connect, policy interpretation, and early employee lifecycle matters for assigned teams.



  





**Skills Required** 



* Strong business acumen with the ability to understand workforce needs in a scaling business environment.
* Strong execution excellence, ownership, urgency, and follow\-through.
* Good understanding of recruitment processes, sourcing channels, candidate management, and hiring coordination.
* Ability to engage effectively with managers, candidates, and internal stakeholders.
* Strong communication skills, attention to detail, and comfort working in a fast\-paced environment.



  





**Role 2: HR Business Partner \& Talent Management** 




 To support talent management priorities for assigned business teams through effective execution of performance processes, employee engagement initiatives, development planning, and HR business partnering support, while also contributing to recruitment delivery for assigned functions. HRBP\-led talent management typically includes performance management, manager enablement, employee development, and workforce effectiveness.
 



  





**Key Deliverables:** 



* Support execution of performance management processes, including goal setting, review coordination, documentation, and follow\-up actions.
* Drive talent management interventions such as employee engagement inputs, development planning support, and talent review coordination.
* Partner with managers on people issues, employee experience, and implementation of core HR processes for assigned teams.
* Support onboarding effectiveness, employee connect mechanisms, and retention\-related follow\-up.
* Contribute to recruitment delivery for assigned business functions as part of the common hiring charter.



  





**Skills Required** 



* Strong business acumen and ability to align people priorities with business goals.
* Good understanding of performance management, employee engagement, development planning, and talent processes.
* Strong execution discipline, stakeholder coordination, and follow\-through.
* Good interpersonal sensitivity and maturity in handling employee\-facing matters.
* Strong communication skills, professionalism, and comfort working in a fast\-paced environment.



  





**ACADEMIC REQUIREMENTS**

**COMPENSATION**

**WHAT WILL YOU GET?**

title: Recruiting Coordinator
description:
**Who Are We?**
 Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million\+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500\. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API\-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.
   

  

 The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore \- where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.
   

  

 P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API\-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The Recruiting Operations Coordinator is the operational backbone of Postman's recruiting function. In this role, you will ensure that every search runs smoothly from open to close — keeping interviews scheduled, data clean, feedback flowing, and candidates well\-informed throughout their experience. This is an ideal role for someone early in their career who is organized, detail\-oriented, and excited to build foundational expertise in talent acquisition at a fast\-growing technology company. You will work closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates, and will play a direct role in how Postman is perceived as an employer.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
*Interview Coordination*
* Own end\-to\-end interview scheduling across all active roles, coordinating availability between candidates, interviewers, and hiring managers with a high degree of accuracy and responsiveness
* Send timely confirmations, reminders, and logistical details to all interview participants
* Manage reschedules and last\-minute changes with professionalism and minimal disruption to the process
* Proactively identify and solve scheduling or process bottlenecks, continuously improving recruiting workflows and coordination processes


*Data Integrity \& ATS Hygiene*
* Audit active job requisitions to ensure all required fields are complete and accurate in the ATS — including job details, compensation bands, stage statuses, and interviewer assignments
* Flag and resolve data gaps in collaboration with recruiters before they affect reporting
* Ensure every closed role has a complete and accurate record before it is archived


*Feedback \& Interview Completion*
* Monitor interview completion rates and follow up with interviewers to ensure feedback is submitted within expected SLAs
* Track which interviews have been recorded and flag any gaps to the relevant recruiter
* Maintain a real\-time view of where feedback is outstanding across all active searches


*Candidate Experience \& Surveys*
* Deliver a high\-touch, candidate\-first experience across every stage of the interview process
* Coordinate the distribution of candidate experience surveys at key touchpoints in the process
* Track response rates and flag low engagement to the recruiting team
* Compile survey results on a regular cadence and summarize key themes for review


*Employer Brand Monitoring*
* Monitor Glassdoor, LinkedIn, Blind, and other relevant platforms for new candidate and employee reviews related to the recruiting and interview experience
* Surface notable feedback to the recruiting team on a regular basis
* Help maintain the accuracy of Postman's employer profiles across platforms


*Metrics \& Reporting*
* Collect and organize data on completed roles, including time to fill, source, offer acceptance, and interview\-to\-offer ratios
* Prepare regular metric summaries for the Head of Recruiting
* Support the team in ensuring data is ready and accurate for monthly and quarterly reporting cycles


**About You**
 You are someone who takes genuine pride in keeping things running well. You notice when something is missing before anyone else does, and you follow through without needing to be reminded. You are comfortable working across multiple workstreams simultaneously and can shift priorities calmly when something urgent comes up.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* Bachelor's degree in any discipline; coursework or internship experience in HR, business, communications, or operations is a plus but not required
* 2\-4 years of professional experience; strong internship or project\-based experience is equally valued
* Exceptional attention to detail — you catch the things others miss
* Strong written communication skills; you can write a clear, professional message to a candidate or a senior hiring manager with equal ease
* Comfort with tools like Google Workspace, spreadsheets, and calendar management; experience with an ATS (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday) is a bonus
* A collaborative, low\-ego working style — you understand that your work makes everyone around you more effective
* Curiosity about how recruiting works as a function and interest in growing within talent acquisition or HR operations over time
* Thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment while managing multiple priorities with strong ownership and attention to detail


**What Else?**
 In addition to Postman's pay\-on\-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team\-building events will keep you connected, while our donation\-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long\-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.
   

  

 At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in\-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.
   

  

**Our Values**
 At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Title \- HR Manager** 




**No of positions: 1** 




**Industry: Internet/Web Software** 




**Employment Type: Full Time** 




**Location: Noida (Work from Office) \- Six days' week** 




  





**Role Overview:**




 The HR Manager at SiteRecon will serve as both a strategic partner and an operational leader for our People function. This is a high\-ownership, hands\-on role suited for someone who has grown through the HR ranks and is ready to run an entire HR function independently at a fast\-moving startup.
 



  





 You will lead the HR team, manage end\-to\-end HR operations, and be the driving force behind implementing and scaling our HRMS. You will work directly with the founders and leadership team to build the people infrastructure that will take SiteRecon from its current stage to the next level of growth.
 



  





 This is not a policy\-maintenance role. We want someone who can build systems, automate manual work, challenge the status quo, and make HR a competitive advantage for the business. Above all, you will be the primary custodian of SiteRecon's culture — ensuring our values are lived and experienced at every level, every day.
 



  





**About Siterecon:**




 SiteRecon is helping property maintenance contractors in the US to automate property mapping and site visits through our mapping platform, giving back time, speeding up their sales process, and increasing their profitability. We are building the next\-generation property intelligence platform and looking for people to help out on our mission to revolutionize how businesses make decisions in North America.
 



  





**About the Team:** 




 Started by IIT Delhi alumni who have worked with multinationals in satellite imaging, e\-commerce, and edtech sectors.
 



 To learn more about the team \& our origin story \- https://order.siterecon.ai/about\-us
 



 To learn more about what we do for our customers \- https://order.siterecon.ai
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**




**Company Culture \& Employee Experience** 



* Champion and uphold the company's values and culture across all levels — ensuring they are consistently demonstrated in day\-to\-day interactions, not just written on a wall.
* Act as the primary custodian of organizational culture by fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and high\-performance work environment.
* Drive employee engagement initiatives that strengthen team morale, trust, and sense of belonging across the organization.
* Ensure every stage of the employee lifecycle — from onboarding to exit — reflects and reinforces the company's culture and values.
* Monitor employee sentiment through structured feedback mechanisms; recommend and implement initiatives to improve workplace experience and retention.



  





**HR Strategy \& Leadership** 



* Collaborate directly with the CEO and leadership team to design and execute a people strategy aligned with SiteRecon's business objectives and growth trajectory.
* Lead, mentor, and assess the performance of the HR team (team of 3\), setting clear goals and holding the team accountable.
* Build and refine HR policies, frameworks, and processes from scratch or improve existing ones to match scale.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labor laws and employment regulations at all times.



  





**Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Management** 



* Own the full\-cycle recruitment process — from defining hiring requirements with managers to offer roll\-out and onboarding.
* Build scalable hiring pipelines for both tech and operations roles, managing different profiles from software engineers to operations staff.
* Develop and manage onboarding frameworks that get new hires productive and culturally integrated quickly.
* Lead exit processes with structured offboarding and capture insights through exit interviews to reduce attrition.
* Develop workforce plans to support operational peaks and business scaling needs.



  





**HRMS Implementation \& Process Automation** 



* Lead the end\-to\-end implementation of SiteRecon's HRMS — own requirements gathering, workflow design, developer feedback loops, UAT, and go\-live.
* Translate HR processes into clear functional requirements for the development team building on the HRMS.
* Drive HRMS adoption across the HR team and the wider organization, reducing dependency on manual, spreadsheet\-based workflows.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive HR tasks (attendance, payroll inputs, leave management, appraisals) and execute on them.
* Act as the internal product owner for all HR technology — evaluate tools, champion adoption, and continuously improve digital workflows.



  





**HR Operations \& Employee Relations** 



* Oversee all day\-to\-day HR operations — payroll coordination, attendance, compliance, documentation, and employee records.
* Foster a strong employee relations culture by being accessible, fair, and consistent in handling grievances, disputes, and disciplinary matters.
* Act as a bridge between the operations/shop\-floor teams and senior management to build trust and transparent communication.
* Ensure clear and timely communication of company policies, expectations, and any organizational changes.
* Mediate conflicts with a balanced and constructive approach.
* Conduct periodic reviews of HR policies to ensure continued relevance and effectiveness; proactively identify gaps and design improved policies where needed.
* Ensure timely rollout and company\-wide implementation of all policy changes.



  





**Performance Management** 



* Design and implement a robust performance management framework — goal setting, mid\-year check\-ins, appraisals, and feedback cycles.
* Drive company\-wide adoption of the performance framework; ensure consistent implementation across all functions, not just on paper.
* Hold managers accountable to review timelines — track completion rates and escalate delays to leadership.
* Champion merit\-based appraisal outcomes — compensation and rewards anchored to demonstrated impact and performance, not tenure or seniority.
* Work with managers to define meaningful KPIs for their teams and ensure consistent implementation.
* Identify skill gaps and underperformance early; support managers with coaching, PIP design, and structured interventions.
* Champion a culture of continuous feedback and accountability across the organization.



  





**Learning \& Development** 



* Assess training needs across teams and design L\&D programs that address skill gaps and build leadership capability.
* Drive a culture of continuous learning — encourage participation in development programs and track their business impact.
* Partner with functional leads to create role\-specific onboarding and upskilling programs for operations and tech teams.



  





**HR Metrics \& Reporting** 



* Own HR analytics and reporting — provide leadership with regular, data\-driven insights on headcount, attrition, hiring velocity, engagement, and performance.
* Use data to proactively identify people risks and recommend corrective actions before they become problems.
* Build dashboards and reporting cadences that give leadership real\-time visibility into people metrics.



  





**Qualifications:**




**Education** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Psychology, or a related field.
* Advanced certifications such as SHRM\-CP/SHRM\-SCP, PHR/SPHR, or equivalent are a plus.



  





**Experience (All Required)** 



* 8\+ years of progressive HR experience, with meaningful exposure across the full HR spectrum — recruitment, operations, compliance, employee relations, and performance management.
* At least 2–3 years in a role where you led or significantly influenced HR strategy, not just executed it.
* Demonstrated experience leading or managing a small HR team.
* Hands\-on experience implementing or configuring an HRMS — including requirements gathering, working with developers, conducting UAT, and driving adoption.
* Experience in a startup, high\-growth tech company, or operations\-heavy business strongly preferred.
* Prior exposure to managing a digital\-factory or operations\-floor workforce (blue\-collar or semi\-technical teams) is an advantage.



  





**Technical Skills** 



* Proficiency in HRIS/HRMS platforms and HR analytics tools.
* Ability to translate HR process requirements into functional specs for engineering or product teams.
* Solid understanding of Indian labor laws, workplace compliance, and statutory requirements.
* Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets for HR reporting; exposure to data visualization tools is a plus.



  





**Key Competencies** 



* Ownership mindset — you treat HR like your own business unit and hold yourself accountable for outcomes, not just activities.
* Strong communication skills in both English and Hindi (written and verbal).
* Strategic thinking with the ability to zoom out and see the big picture, while also executing day\-to\-day operations without dropping the ball.
* Influencing without authority — able to drive behavioral change across the organization even without a large team.
* Analytical and data\-driven approach to identifying problems and making recommendations.
* High adaptability and comfort with ambiguity in a fast\-paced startup environment.
* Strong conflict resolution and mediation skills.



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Prior experience in a product\-led or SaaS company.
* Expertise in change management and driving organizational behavior shifts.
* Experience designing and delivering both technical and behavioral training programs.
* Familiarity with remote or distributed workforce management.



  





**Perks of Working at SiteRecon** 



* Work ownership — if you see something that adds value, you have the freedom to own and execute it.
* Minimum opacity between you and leadership. Work directly with the founders of a fast\-growing company.
* Direct communication with key stakeholders — get real\-time insights and feedback on your work.
* Freedom to speak up, challenge the status quo, and suggest meaningful improvements.
* Full visibility into the operational side of the business — understand the bigger picture and see how your HR work directly impacts company outcomes

title: Senior Manager, Employee Relations (Bangkok-based, Relocation Provided)
description:
**About Agoda**
 At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
   

  

 Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
   

  

 No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
   

  

**Get To Know Our Team:**
 The People Team is a purveyor of opportunity, searching the globe for the most talented individuals and offering them an open, collaborative workplace. By prioritizing skill and potential, we have cultivated a powerful assembly of professionals through our drive for equal opportunity and diversity. We make the move to Agoda a breeze with assisted onboarding programs, and we continue to support and enrich our thousands of Agoda employees through individual growth with outstanding learning programs and various means of assistance. Our development of incredible benefits has ensured everyone can stay strong, healthy, and happy during their time at Agoda. Leading ambitious changes and making a positive impact in the lives of our employees, the People Team is a crucial and rewarding part of the Agoda family.
   

  

**The Opportunity:**
 We are looking for someone to lead our Global Employee Relations Team as a Senior Manager, Employee Relations. This role leads the development of policies, advisory standards, case governance and analytics to ensure fair, consistent and legally sound people practices. The incumbent partners closely with HR leadership, Legal, unions, and government agencies to manage complex disciplinary matters, labor relations issues and emerging workforce risks.
   

  

 The role combines deep industrial relationships expertise, policy leadership, stakeholder influence, and data\-driven decision making, and serves as a subject\-matter authority on employment legislation and industrial relations strategy.
   

  

 Our Employee Relations consultants work closely with key stakeholders including our Legal/Compliance team, Corporate Tax, Corporate Governance, Talent Business Partner team and the Senior Management Team to support employees in challenging circumstances, and we seek to identify trends and share insights to adjust our people management practices to get the best talent outcomes. We advise and enable managers to make the best possible decisions, challenging practices that go beyond legal obligation to protect our unique culture at Agoda.
   

  

**What You’ll Do:**
* Elevate Compliance and Policy Expertise: Act as the go\-to specialist on ER Matters, guiding managers in adhering to company policies, local laws, and regulations. Establish governance standards, operating guidelines and decision frameworks to ensure consistency across the organization. Translate employment legislation, case law and regulatory changes into clear institutional policies and guidance.
* Enhance Manager Effectiveness: Lead the design, review and implementation and advise people managers on the Organization\-wide employee \& labor relations and HR policy framework. Critically evaluate systemic issues in manager capability and practices and escalate them appropriately to business leaders for sustainable resolution.
* Union Engagement: Represent the organization in union consultations, negotiations, arbitration and dispute resolution forums. Analyze union and management proposals to assess policy, financial and employee\-relations implications. Support collective bargaining strategies through data, benchmarking and scenario analysis.
* Streamline Disciplinary and Termination Processes: Ensure accurate execution and documentation of disciplinary actions and terminations to minimize labor disputes.
* Lead Investigations and Employee Relations processes: Conduct impartial investigations into grievances and serve as a dedicated Employee Relations partner, identifying trends and insights to inform procedural improvements.
* Drive Performance and Policy Enhancements through Analytics: Analyze performance management data and past misconduct cases to develop recommendations for capability\-building, policy revisions, training enhancements, and more effective management practices.
* Optimize Performance Management and Offboarding: Spearhead improvements in performance management systems and refine offboarding processes, incorporating data from different sources to enhance employee experiences.
* Regulatory \& Dispute Management: Liaise with Legal team to represent and manage the Company in negotiations, arbitrations and dispute resolution forums or other regulatory authorities.


**Required Qualifications:**
* Deep understanding of employee relations, labor relations and workplace dispute management.
* Strong working knowledge of employment legislation, regulations and industrial relations practices.
* Ability to interpret legislation and apply it practically within complex organizational environments.
* Advanced stakeholder management and influencing capability across senior leaders, unions and regulators.
* Strong negotiation, mediation and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Ability to balance organizational risk with empathy and sound judgement.
* Degree in Human Resource Management, Law, Industrial Relations, or related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* A minimum of 13 years in Employee and Labor Relations or HR Business Partnering roles within large or regulated organizations, with a proven track record of handling complex employee relations issues.
* Extensive knowledge of employment laws and regulations in the relevant region, with the ability to interpret and apply them in various scenarios.
* Hands\-on experience managing and executing restructuring/change management projects
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders
* Ability to cope well with ambiguity and change
* High level of discretion, confidentiality, and ethical standards in handling sensitive information and situations.
* Sound judgment and the ability to make well\-informed decisions, balancing legal compliance with business needs.
* Proficiency in using data and analytics to inform decision\-making processes and improve employee relations strategies.
* Fluency in written and spoken English, with strong communication skills to effectively convey complex information.
* Demonstrated leadership qualities and a desire to take on managerial responsibilities in the future.


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Curiosity, ready to challenge current practices and perspectives
* Great attention to detail
* Great sense of ownership and reliability
* Multicultural or International Experience

title: HR Fresher
description:
We are hiring an Human Resources Fresher who can support HR operations through data analysis, reporting, dashboards, and modern AI tools.
   

  

 This role is suitable for freshers or early\-career candidates who are interested in Human Resources, data analytics, Power BI, Excel/Google Sheets, and AI\-enabled work. The ideal candidate should not only understand HR processes but should also be comfortable working with data, creating reports, identifying patterns, and using AI tools to complete work faster and more accurately.
   

  

 The person will work closely with the HR team to analyze recruitment, employee, attendance, performance, and workforce data, build dashboards and reports, and use AI tools to improve speed, accuracy, and decision\-making.
   

  

 Core Job Responsibilities
   

  

* HR Data Analysis \& Reporting Collect, clean, organize, and analyze HR data related to recruitment, employee records, attendance, onboarding, performance, attrition, and workforce planning.
* Power BI Dashboards \& MIS Reporting Create and maintain dashboards, reports, and MIS trackers using tools such as Power BI, Excel, Google Sheets, or similar reporting platforms.
* Recruitment Analytics Track hiring funnel metrics such as applications received, shortlisted candidates, interview status, offer rollout, joining status, turnaround time, source effectiveness, and drop\-off points.
* Workforce Analytics Analyze employee data to identify trends related to headcount, attrition, attendance, performance, engagement, skills, and manpower requirements.
* AI\-Assisted Workflows Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, or similar platforms to speed up data cleaning, report writing, formula creation, dashboard planning, insight generation, documentation, and process improvement.
* Data Interpretation \& Business Insights Convert raw HR data into clear insights and summaries that help the HR team and business leaders make better decisions.
* HR Operations Support Support day\-to\-day HR operations such as onboarding tracking, employee documentation, HRMS data updates, employee query tracking, and process documentation.
* Automation \& Process Improvement Identify repetitive HR reporting or operational tasks and suggest ways to automate or simplify them using Excel, Google Sheets, Power BI, AI tools, or other workflow tools.
* Data Accuracy \& Quality Checks Validate reports and AI\-generated outputs to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability before sharing them with internal stakeholders.
* Data Privacy \& Responsible AI Use Handle employee and candidate data responsibly, maintaining confidentiality and ensuring AI tools are used carefully and ethically.


 Key Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* Strong interest in HR analytics, people data, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, pivot tables, charts, filters, lookup functions, and data cleaning.
* Familiarity with Power BI or willingness to build dashboards using Power BI.
* Ability to interpret data and explain insights in simple business language.
* Hands\-on usage of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, or similar tools for work\-related tasks.
* Ability to write clear prompts, verify AI\-generated outputs, and improve responses through iteration.
* Good communication skills and ability to present findings clearly.
* Strong attention to detail and comfort working with structured data.
* Curiosity to learn new HR tech, analytics tools, and automation methods.


**Preferred Skills**
* Knowledge of Power BI, Power Query, DAX, or dashboard creation.
* Basic understanding of SQL, Python, or data visualization concepts.
* Experience with HRMS, ATS, payroll systems, or employee management tools.
* Prior internship, academic project, or personal project involving data analysis, dashboards, or HR analytics.
* Experience using AI tools to create reports, clean data, generate formulas, summarize trends, or automate repetitive work.
* Understanding of recruitment, onboarding, attendance, performance management, or employee lifecycle processes.


 Eligibility Criteria
   

  

* B.E. / B.Tech degree is mandatory
* MBA degree is mandatory
* Freshers are eligible to apply.
* Candidates with internships, projects, certifications, or practical exposure in HR analytics, Power BI, Excel, or AI tools will be preferred.

description:
Noida, Uttar Pradesh
  
Job Summary
  
  

About the Role
  
  

We are looking for a GenAI Agentic Developer to design, build, integrate, test, and support intelligent applications powered by Large Language Models, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation, tool\-calling workflows, autonomous agents, and agentic AI frameworks. The role requires strong programming fundamentals, practical exposure to GenAI application development, and the ability to connect LLMs with enterprise data sources, APIs, workflow systems, vector databases, and cloud\-based AI services. The candidate should be able to contribute to AI assistants, chatbots, knowledge search solutions, document intelligence use cases, automation agents, and production\-ready GenAI features with appropriate controls for accuracy, reliability, safety, cost, and performance.
  
  

This role is suitable for candidates with 0 to 5 years of relevant experience . Freshers or entry\-level candidates should demonstrate strong project, internship, certification, GitHub, hackathon, academic, or portfolio\-based exposure in Python, GenAI, LLM applications, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, vector search, chatbot development, AI\-assisted automation, or agentic workflow prototypes.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Develop GenAI applications using Python, LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, embeddings, vector search, and agentic AI frameworks.
  
Build AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, tool calling, function calling, workflow orchestration, memory usage, task decomposition, and multi\-step execution.
  
Design and implement RAG and Agentic RAG pipelines using document ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata tagging, embeddings, vector indexing, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, prompt construction, and grounded response generation.
  
Integrate GenAI solutions with structured and unstructured enterprise data sources such as documents, databases, SharePoint repositories, knowledge bases, APIs, ticketing systems, and workflow platforms.
  
Implement prompt templates, system prompts, reusable prompt libraries, structured outputs, JSON response formats, prompt versioning, and output validation logic.
  
Create tool integrations that allow agents to call APIs, execute workflows, retrieve data, summarize content, classify information, generate reports, and trigger downstream actions safely.
  
Support model selection and configuration based on use case needs such as accuracy, latency, context window, token usage, cost, privacy, and deployment constraints.
  
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, knowledge repositories, search services, and automation workflows.
  
Use frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar tools to build agentic workflows.
  
Create reusable components for prompt templates, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, memory handling, guardrails, model evaluation, tracing, observability, and monitoring.
  
Perform testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for factual accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, groundedness, safety, bias, latency, token usage, cost, and reliability.
  
Implement basic Responsible AI and security controls such as input validation, prompt injection mitigation, PII handling, access control, auditability, and safe response handling.
  
Support deployment and integration of GenAI components into backend services, web applications, automation workflows, and cloud\-hosted environments.
  
Support testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, latency, cost, safety, and reliability.
  
Collaborate with data engineers, backend developers, cloud engineers, QA teams, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver AI\-enabled features.
  
Document prompts, agent flows, API integrations, model configurations, assumptions, limitations, and deployment steps.
  
  

Skill Requirements
  
  

Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  

Strong programming capability in Python , including data structures, APIs, object\-oriented programming, exception handling, logging, debugging, package management, and modular application development.
  
Hands\-on exposure to Generative AI, Large Language Models, prompt engineering, embeddings, tokenization, context windows, structured outputs, and AI application development .
  
Working knowledge of RAG architecture , including document processing, chunking strategies, metadata design, vectorization, semantic search, hybrid search, reranking, context augmentation, and grounded response generation.
  
Experience or strong project exposure in agentic AI concepts such as tool calling, function calling, planning, memory, reflection, reasoning loops, task decomposition, autonomous execution, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and workflow orchestration.
  
Exposure to frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI , or equivalent agentic development frameworks.
  
Experience integrating LLMs through APIs or cloud AI services such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, or open\-source model endpoints.
  
Working knowledge of vector databases or semantic search platforms such as FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search, or pgvector.
  
Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, authentication, backend integration, data ingestion, and application deployment basics.
  
Working knowledge of Git, code reviews, debugging practices, documentation, and Agile delivery methods.
  
  

Preferred / Additional Skills
  
  

Exposure to cloud\-native AI services, especially AWS Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Google Vertex AI, or Gemini APIs.
  
Familiarity with multi\-agent systems, supervisor\-agent patterns, planner\-executor workflows, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and agent evaluation methods.
  
Knowledge of LLMOps or GenAIOps practices, including prompt versioning, model configuration management, monitoring, tracing, evaluation, and cost tracking.
  
Exposure to OCR, document intelligence, NLP, text classification, summarization, entity extraction, and enterprise knowledge search use cases.
  
Basic understanding of model evaluation metrics, hallucination reduction, grounded responses, guardrails, responsible AI, privacy, and security controls.
  
Experience with FastAPI, Flask, Streamlit, React, Node.js, or similar tools for building AI\-enabled applications and demos.
  
Other Requirements
  
  

Experience Criteria
  
  

0 to 5 years of relevant experience in GenAI development, AI application engineering, Python development, ML/NLP application development, backend development, or automation engineering.
  
Candidates with 0–1 year of experience should demonstrate capability through academic projects, internships, certifications, GitHub repositories, hackathons, prototypes, or hands\-on GenAI experiments.
  
Candidates with 2–5 years of experience should have hands\-on experience building, integrating, testing, or deploying GenAI, AI assistant, chatbot, RAG, automation, or agentic workflow solutions.
  
  

Educational Qualifications
  
  

**Mandatory Qualification:**  

B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electronics, Software Engineering, or any other relevant engineering stream.
  
  

**Equivalent qualifications may also be considered:**  

BCA / MCA / M.Tech / M.Sc. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, or related disciplines from a recognized institution or university.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Why Choose Bottomline?
   

  

 Are you ready to transform the way businesses pay and get paid? Bottomline is a global leader in business payments and cash management, with over 35 years of experience and moving more than $16 trillion in payments annually. We're looking for passionate individuals to join our team and help drive impactful results for our customers. If you're dedicated to delighting customers and promoting growth and innovation \- we want you on our team!
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 We are hiring a Data Scientist to help transform how the business uses AI, machine learning, and corporate data to improve decisions, workflows, and outcomes.
   

  

 This role will partner directly with business teams and, in many cases, will be forward deployed into the business. The Data Scientist will use the full data science toolkit, including statistical modeling, machine learning, generative AI, optimization, experimentation, forecasting, entity resolution, and advanced analytics, to deliver results.
   

  

 The right candidate understands both the technical depth of data science and the operating reality of the business, selects the right method for the problem, and converts solutions into measurable value.
   

  

 How the Role Works
   

  

 The Data Scientist will move from business problem to usable solution through a practical delivery model:
   

  

* Understand the business outcome, workflow, decision, or constraint that needs to improve.
* Assess available data, data quality, system context, technical feasibility, and governance requirements.
* Select the right approach across statistics, machine learning, generative AI, optimization, simulation, or advanced analytics.
* Build models, prototypes, analyses, and AI\-enabled data products that can be tested with users.
* Evaluate accuracy, reliability, business relevance, operating fit, and measurable impact.
* Partner with Data Engineering, Analytics, IT, AI Solutions Engineering, and business owners to operationalize what works.


 What You Will Do
   

  

 Applied Data Science and Modeling
   

  

* Build models and analytical solutions using machine learning, statistical modeling, forecasting, classification, clustering, anomaly detection, recommendation methods, entity matching, optimization, and causal or experimental analysis where appropriate.
* Apply generative AI and LLM\-based methods where they are the right fit, including summarization, extraction, semantic search, retrieval\-augmented generation, Text\-to\-SQL, document intelligence, and agentic workflows.
* Work with structured and unstructured data, including operational data, customer data, product data, documents, transcripts, contracts, support interactions, and enterprise knowledge sources.
* Evaluate models and AI systems using practical criteria such as accuracy, precision and recall, relevance, groundedness, stability, explainability, safety, adoption, and business value.


 Business Partnership and Problem Definition
   

  

* Partner with business stakeholders to define the problem, clarify the desired outcome, and determine what decisions or workflows need to change.
* Translate ambiguous business questions into clear data science problem statements, solution approaches, and measurable success criteria.
* Communicate findings, model outputs, limitations, and recommendations in plain language that business and technical teams can act on.


 AI, Data Platform, and Delivery
   

  

* Work in a Snowflake\-centered data environment and use its capabilities for analytics, data engineering, machine learning, AI, governed data access, and enterprise\-scale data products where appropriate.
* Build reusable patterns for models, prompts, features, evaluation, monitoring, and data products that can scale beyond a single use case.
* Partner with technical teams to move solutions from prototype to production use with appropriate controls, documentation, monitoring, and responsible AI practices.


 Thought Leadership
   

  

* Bring current knowledge of AI and data science methods, including frontier models, open\-source models, enterprise AI platforms, and applied machine learning practices.
* Help leaders understand where AI and machine learning can create value, where traditional analytics is the better answer, and where foundational data work is required.
* Recommend practical approaches that balance speed, accuracy, cost, governance, security, and business impact.


 What We Are Looking For
   

  

**Required Experience**
* Demonstrable results delivering data science, machine learning, analytics, or AI projects that improved business processes, decisions, operations, customer outcomes, or revenue outcomes.
* Strong technical foundation in Python, SQL, applied statistics, machine learning, model evaluation, feature engineering, experimentation, and data analysis.
* Hands\-on experience building models or AI\-enabled data products in a business environment.
* Experience working with structured and unstructured enterprise data.
* Experience partnering with business stakeholders to define problems, interpret results, explain tradeoffs, and support adoption.
* Ability to operate with imperfect data, make practical tradeoffs, and iterate based on real business feedback.


**Strongly Preferred**
* Experience with Snowflake, including analytics, data engineering, machine learning, Cortex, governed data access, or enterprise\-scale data products.
* Experience with modern data and AI platforms such as Databricks, ClickHouse, Spark, cloud AI/ML services, or comparable environments.
* Experience with generative AI and LLM application patterns such as RAG, embeddings, semantic search, prompt design, Text\-to\-SQL, agents, orchestration, and evaluation.
* Experience with model deployment, monitoring, observability, reproducible workflows, version control, documentation, and responsible AI controls.
* Experience working across business, IT, Data Engineering, Analytics, Data Science, and AI delivery teams.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Success means the Data Scientist helps the business use AI, machine learning, and corporate data to make better decisions and improve how work gets done. The role should produce models, analyses, AI\-enabled applications, and data products that are adopted by business teams, improve measurable outcomes, and create repeatable patterns we can scale across the company.
   

  

 What We Offer
   

  

* The opportunity to apply modern AI, machine learning, and data science to meaningful business problems across critical functions.
* Direct partnership with business and technology leaders on high\-priority transformation efforts.

**Junior AI  Backend Engineer** 




**Mode:** 
 Remote / Hybrid
 



**Experience:** 
 1\-3 Years
 



**ABOUT US** 




 We are an engineering team building AI agent systems that automate complex knowledge work — document generation, structured reasoning, and multi\-step task orchestration. Our systems are deployed in production and used by real teams to make real decisions.We build carefully, govern rigorously, and take quality seriously.
 



**THE IMPACT YOU WILL MAKE** 




 As a Junior AI / Backend Engineer, you will be responsible for building the backend services and agent pipelines that make LLM outputs reliable, structured, and safe to use in production. Your work will sit at the foundation of every agent capability we ship.
 



 This is systems engineering around AI models
 



**WHAT YOU WILL DO** 



* **API Development:** 
 Design and maintain FastAPI services that expose agent capabilities as clean, versioned APIs.
* **Agent Pipelines:** 
 Build LangChain orchestration pipelines with structured I/O contracts, retry logic, and fallback handling.
* **Cloud Infrastructure:** 
 Work with Azure infrastructure including Azure OpenAI Service, Blob Storage, and Container Apps.
* **Output Reliability:** 
 Implement output validation and schema enforcement layers that make LLM responses trustworthy enough for production use.
* **Codebase Contribution:** 
 Write code that your teammates can read, review, and build on without friction.
  

  



**WHAT YOU WILL BRING** 




**Required** 




 – 1\-3 years of Python development with at least one production deployment behind you.
 



 – Solid grasp of async Python and REST API design, with the debugging instincts to match.
 



 – Hands\-on experience with LangChain or a comparable LLM orchestration library.
 



 – Working knowledge of Azure: OpenAI Service, Blob Storage, and App Service or Container Apps.
 



 – You understand why output validation, structured schemas, and retry logic matter in production — not just that they exist.
 



 – Comfortable working in a shared codebase with other engineers.
 



**Preferred** 




 – Pydantic for structured output parsing and schema validation.
 



 – Experience with RAG pipelines or document ingestion workflows.
 



 – Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions for CI/CD.
 



 – Any prior work building multi\-step or tool\-using LLM agents.
 



**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** 




 We are not looking for someone who knows everything. We are looking for someone who ships, learns, and communicates clearly. A strong candidate will be able to show:
 



 – You have built a REST API that other services depend on.
 



 – You have integrated an external API and handled its failure modes, not just the happy path.
 



 – You can explain a design decision, defend it under pushback, and revise it when shown a better argument.
 



**OUT OF SCOPE FOR THIS ROLE** 




 In the interest of honesty, the following are not part of this position:
 



 – Prompt engineering as the primary responsibility.
 



 – Frontend or UI development.
 



 – Machine learning model training or fine\-tuning.
 



 – Autonomous deployment to production environments without engineer review.
 



**TECHNOLOGY STACK** 




 Python  \|  FastAPI  \|  LangChain  \|  Azure OpenAI  \|  Azure Blob Storage  \|  Container Apps  \|  Pydantic  \|  GitHub / Azure DevOps
 



**WHY WORK WITH US** 




 – You will work on systems that are used in real projects by real teams — not internal demos or sandboxed experiments.
 



 – You will work closely with senior engineers and architects, not be left to figure things out alone.
 



 – Code quality, system design, and governance are taken seriously here. Your standards will be matched.
 



 – Remote\-friendly and outcome\-focused. We care about what you ship, not when you log in.
